verses.text: Iyi ni yo ntango y’Ubutumwa Bwiza bwa Yesu Kristo, Umwana w’Imana.
Bwatanguye nk’uko vyari vyaranditswe n’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya ngo: “Ngira ndungike intumwa yanje imbere yawe, igutegurire inzira”:
Uwo ni “Ijwi ry’uwusemerera mu bugaragwa, ati: ‘Nimutegurire Uhoraho aho aca, mugorore inzira agenderamwo.’ ”
Uko ni ko Yohana Umubatizi yaserutse mu bugaragwa yigisha umubatizo wo kwihana ngo abantu baharirwe ivyaha.
Abantu benshi baragenda bavuye mu ntara ya Yudaya no mu gisagara ca Yerusalemu bakaja iyo ari. Bamaze kwatura ivyaha vyabo, yaca ababatiza mu ruzi Yorodani.
Yohana yambara impuzu ikozwe mu bwoya bw’ingamiya, akayikenyeza umukanda w’urusato mu rukenyerero. Ivyokurya vyiwe vyari inzige n’ubuki bwo mw’ishamba.
Yigisha avuga ati: “Uwuje inyuma yanje arandusha ubushobozi ku buryo bitanambereye kwunama ngo mpfundurure utugozi tw’ibirato vyiwe.
Jewe ndababatiza mu mazi, ariko we azobabatiza muri Mpwemu Yera.”
Muri ico gihe, Yesu ava i Nazareti mu ntara y’i Galilaya, aja ku ruzi Yorodani, abatizwa na Yohana.
Akiva mu mazi, abona ijuru ryugurutse, Mpwemu Yera amuzako asa n’inuma.
Maze ijwi ryumvikana rivuye mw’ijuru riti: “Uri Umwana wanje nkunda, akampimbara.”
Muri ako kanya nyene, Mpwemu Yera aca ajana Yesu mu bugaragwa,
ahamara imisi mirongo ine ageragezwa na Satani. Yabana n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba, kandi abamarayika bakaza bakamukorera.
Yohana amaze gutabwa mw’ibohero, Yesu aca aja i Galilaya avuga Ubutumwa Bwiza bw’Imana,
ati: “Igihe kirashitse, Ubwami bw’Imana buri hafi. Nimwihane mwizere Ubutumwa Bwiza.”
Umusi umwe, Yesu ariko aragendagenda ku nkengera y’ikiyaga c’i Galilaya, abona Simoni na mwene nyina Andereya, bariko baterera urusenga mu kiyaga, kuko bari abarovyi.
Arababwira ati: “Nimunkurikire, nzobagira abarovyi b’abantu.”
Ubwo nyene baca basiga ngaho insenga zabo, baramukurikira.
Yigiye imbere gato, abona Yakobo na Yohana bene Zebedayo bariko barasana insenga zabo mu bwato.
Ubwo nyene aca arabahamagara, na bo basiga se Zebedayo n’abakozi biwe mu bwato baramukurikira.
Nuko Yesu ajana na bo i Kaperinawumu. Umusi w’Isabato ushitse, yinjira mw’isinagogi arigisha.
Abamwumviriza batangazwa n’inyigisho ziwe, kuko yigishanya ububasha, mu buryo butandukanye n’ubw’abigisha b’ivyagezwe.
Ako kanya nyene, muri iyo sinagogi, umuntu yarimwo impwemu ihumanye, atangura gusemerera ati:
“Yesu w’i Nazareti, uturonderako iki? Uzanywe no kuduhonya? Ndazi uwo uri we. Uri Uwera w’Imana!”
Yesu arayizibiza ati: “Hora! Muvemwo!”
Ya mpwemu mbi ica iramujegeza hanyuma imuvamwo ivuza induru nyinshi.
Abantu bose baratangara, barabazanya bati: “Mbega ibi ni ibiki? Ni inyigisho nshasha kandi zirimwo ububasha! N’impwemu mbi na zo arazitegeka zikamwumvira!”
Maze inkuru ziwe zica zikwira mu ntara yose ya Galilaya.
Bavuye mw’isinagogi, Yesu aca ajana na Yakobo na Yohana i muhira kwa Simoni na Andereya.
Bahashitse, baca babwira Yesu ko inabukwe wa Simoni ari ku buriri, agwaye kandi ashushe cane.
Nuko Yesu yegera aho ari, amufata ukuboko, aramuhagurutsa. Bwa bushuhe buca burahera, aca arabazimana.
Ku mugoroba izuba rimaze kurenga, bazanira Yesu abagwaye benshi n’ababoshwe n’abadayimoni.
Abantu bose bo muri ico gisagara bakoranira imbere y’umuryango yari arimwo.
Nuko Yesu akiza abantu benshi bari bagwaye ingwara zitandukanye. Yirukana n’impwemu mbi nyinshi, ntiyazemerera kugira ico zivuga kuko zari zamenye uwo ari we.
Mu gitondo ca kare butaraca, Yesu aravyuka, arasohoka aja gusengera ahantu hiherereye.
Maze Simoni n’abari kumwe na we baja kumurondera.
Bamubonye baramubwira bati: “Abantu bose bariko barakurondera.”
Na we arabishura ati: “Nimuze tuje mu yindi mihana yo hafi nje kwigishayo, kuko ari co canzanye.”
Nuko agendagenda mu ntara yose ya Galilaya, avuga Ubutumwa Bwiza mu masinagogi, yirukana n’abadayimoni.
Umuntu agwaye imibembe araza apfukama imbere yiwe, aramwinginga ati: “Ubishatse, woshobora kunkiza ngahumanuka.”
Yesu aterwa ikigongwe n’uwo muntu maze aramvura ukuboko amukorako, aramubwira ati: “Ndabishatse, kira uhumanuke!”
Ubwo nyene ya mibembe ica iramuvako arahumanuka.
Yesu aca aramurungika, aramwihanikiriza ati:
“Ntihagire umuntu n’umwe ubibwira. Ariko genda ku muherezi agusuzume hanyuma utange ikimazi Mose yashinze ko uwuhumanutse atanga, kugira ngo bose bamenye ko wahumanutse.”

Aho guhora, wa muntu aca aragenda atangura kuvuga no gukwiragiza iyo nkuru. Ivyo vyatumye Yesu adasubira kuja mu gisagara ku mugaragaro, ahubwo aca aguma inyuma yaco ahantu hihishije. Ariko na ho nyene abantu barahamusanga bavuye mu mihingo myinshi.

headings.text: Yesu ahamagara abigishwa biwe ba mbere
Yesu yirukana impwemu mbi mu muntu

verses.text: Haciye imisi, Yesu asubira i Kaperinawumu, maze inkuru iramenyekana ko yagarutse i muhira.
Abantu benshi bakoranira aho hantu haruzura ku buryo n’imbere y’umuryango ata kibanza cari kihasigaye.
Nuko haza abantu bane bateruye ku nderuzo umuntu akongataye.
Ariko kubera ubwinshi bw’abantu, ntivyakunda ko bashikira Yesu. Baca basambura ahantu hato ku nzu hejuru y’aho Yesu yari ari, bururukirizamwo ya nderuzo wa muntu aryamyeko.
Yesu abonye ukwizera kwabo, abwira uwo muntu amugaye ati: “Mwana wanje, ivyaha vyawe urabihariwe.”
Bamwe mu bigisha b’ivyagezwe bari ngaho batangura kwibaza mu mitima yabo bati:
“Uwo mugabo yubahutse gute kuvuga gutyo? Ukwo ni ugutuka Imana! Ni nde ashobora guharira ivyaha atari Imana yonyene?”
Ubwo nyene Yesu amenya mu mpwemu yiwe ivyo bariko baribaza mu mitima yabo. Arababaza ati: “Ni kuki muriko mwiyumvira gutyo mu mitima yanyu?
Mbega icoroshe ni uko nobwira uwu muntu amugaye nti: ‘Ivyaha vyawe urabihariwe,’ canke ni uko novuga nti: ‘Haguruka wikorere inderuzo yawe ugende’?
Ariko nshaka ko mutahura ko Umwana w’Umuntu afise ububasha kw’isi bwo guharira ivyaha.” Nuko aca abwira uwo muntu ati:
“Haguruka, ikorere inderuzo yawe, witahire.”
Wa muntu aca arahaguruka, aterura inderuzo yiwe, asohoka bose babibona. Abantu bose baratangara, bahimbaza Imana bavuga bati: “Ntitwari bwabone ibintu nk’ibi!”
Yesu yongera kuja ku nkengera y’ikiyaga c’i Galilaya. Nuko abantu benshi baza aho ari na we atangura kubigisha.
Ariko ararengana, abona Lewi mwene Alufayo yicaye aho yatoreza ikori, amubwira ati: “Nkurikira!” Lewi aca ava hasi, aramukurikira.
Maze Yesu acicaye mu nzu kwa Lewi ngo bamuzimane, haza abatozakori n’abanyavyaha benshi basangira na Yesu n’abigishwa biwe; kuko mu bakurikira Yesu harimwo benshi bameze nk’abo.
Bamwe mu bigisha b’ivyagezwe b’Abafarisayo babonye Yesu asangira n’abatozakori n’abandi banyavyaha, babaza abigishwa biwe bati: “Ni kuki asangira n’abatozakori n’abandi banyavyaha?”
Yesu avyumvise, abishura ati: “Abakomeye si bo bakeneye umuganga, ahubwo abagwaye ni bo bamukeneye. Sinaje guhamagara abagororotsi, ahubwo naje guhamagara abanyavyaha.”

Ikindi gihe, abigishwa ba Yohana n’Abafarisayo bari bisonzesheje. Maze abantu baza aho Yesu ari baramubaza bati: “Ni kuki abigishwa ba Yohana Umubatizi n’abigishwa b’Abafarisayo bisonzesha, ariko abigishwa bawe ntibisonzeshe?”
Yesu arabishura ati: “Mbega abatumire b’umukwe bokwisonzesha bakiri kumwe na we mu musi mukuru? Ntibishoboka!
Ariko hazogera aho umukwe abakurwamwo; ico gihe bazoheza bisonzeshe.
Nta wofata igitambara gishasha ngo akibaririre ku mpuzu y’umushire, kuko ico gitambara cotuma ya mpuzu y’umushire itabuka rwose.

Ni nk’uko ata wosuka umuvinyu mushasha mu mukuza w’urusato ushaje, kuko uwo muvinyu wotuma uwo mukuza umeneka; hanyuma wa muntu akabura umuvinyu n’umukuza. Ahubwo umuvinyu mushasha bawushira mu mukuza mushasha.”
Umusi umwe, ku musi w’Isabato, Yesu yariko aca mu mirima y’ingano ari kumwe n’abigishwa biwe. Bariko bararengana, abigishwa biwe bagenda baraca imitwe y’ingano zeze.
Abafarisayo baramubaza bati: “Ni kuki abigishwa bawe bakora ikizira ku musi w’Isabato?”
Yesu arabishura ati: “Mbega ntimurasoma ivyo Dawidi yakoze igihe we n’abo bari kumwe bari bashonje, ata co kurya bafise?
Yinjiye mu nzu y’Imana, mu gihe c’umuherezi mukuru Abiyatari, arya imikate yashikaniwe Imana; kandi abaherezi ari bo bonyene bari bemerewe kuyirya; yongera ahako n’abari kumwe na we.”
Yesu aca arababwira ati: “Isabato yashizweho ku neza y’umuntu, umuntu ntiyaremewe kuganzwa na yo,
ni co gituma Umwana w’Umuntu ari na we Mwami w’Isabato.”
Ikindi gihe Yesu yinjira mw’isinagogi ahasanga umuntu akongataye ukuboko.
Bamwe mu bari aho bamuhanga amaso ngo barabe ko amukiza, kuko barondera ico bofatirako kugira ngo bamwagirize ko yakoze ku musi w’Isabato kandi kizira.
Yesu abwira wa muntu akongataye ukuboko ati: “Haguruka uhagarare hano imbere y’aba bantu bose.”
Arababaza ati: “Mbega icemewe gukorwa ku musi w’Isabato ni ikihe? Iciza canke ikibi? Gukiza umuntu canke kumwica?” Ntihagira n’umwe amwishura.
Nuko Yesu abitegereza ashavuye, kandi ababajwe cane n’uko imitima yabo ikomantaye. Maze aca abwira uwo muntu ati: “Gorora ukuboko kwawe.” Akugoroye guca kurakira.
Abafarisayo baca baragenda baja inama n’abayoboke ba Herode, y’ingene bokwica Yesu.
Yesu n’abigishwa biwe bava aho hantu baja ku kiyaga, maze abantu isinzi baramukurikira bavuye i Galilaya, i Yudaya,
i Yerusalemu, muri Idumaya, hakurya y’uruzi Yorodani no mu micungararo y’intara za Tiro na Sidoni. Abo bose bamukurikiye kuko bumvise ibitangaza yakoze.
Nuko abwira abigishwa biwe ngo bamutegurire ubwato kugira ngo abantu ntibamugunde,
kuko yari yakijije abantu benshi bituma abagwaye bandi barondera kumukorako.
Abantu baboshwe n’impwemu mbi bamukubise ijisho, izo mpwemu mbi zaca zibakubita hasi zigasemerera ziti: “Uri Umwana w’Imana!”
Ariko we yaca azikankamira ngo zihore, ntizisubire kuvuga uwo ari we.
Hanyuma Yesu aduga ku musozi ahamagara abo agomvye, na bo baza aho ari.
Maze atoranyamwo cumi na babiri, abita intumwa, kugira ngo babane na we yongere abatume kuvuga Ubutumwa Bwiza;
abaha n’ububasha bwo kwirukana abadayimoni.
Aya ni yo mazina y’abo cumi na babiri yatoranije: Simoni (uwo yise Petero);
Yakobo na Yohana bene Zebedayo (na bo abita Bowanerige, bisigura “abana b’inkuba”),
Andereya, Filipo, Baruteremi, Matayo, Toma, Yakobo mwene Alufayo, Tadeyo, Simoni Umuzelote,
na Yuda Isikariyote, ari we yahavuye amugurisha.
Hanyuma Yesu aja i muhira, maze abantu benshi basubira gukoranira aho ari, ku buryo we n’abigishwa biwe bitashoboka ko bafungura.
Abo mu muryango wiwe bavyumvise, baja kumufata, kuko bavuga bati: “Yasaze.”
Abigisha b’ivyagezwe bari baje bava i Yerusalemu bavuga bati: “Akoreshwa n’ububasha bwa Beyelizebuli! Umukuru w’abadayimoni ni we amushoboza kwirukana abadayimoni.”
Yesu arabahamagara ababwira mu migani ati: “Mbega Satani yokwirukana Satani gute?
Iyo ubwami bwiciyemwo ibice, buba bugiye gusenyuka.
Kandi iyo umuryango wiciyemwo ibice, ntushobora kurama.
Iyo Satani yigwanije akicamwo ibice, ntashobora guhagarara, ivyiwe biba biheze.
Nta muntu yokwinjira mu nzu y’umunyenkomezi ngo amunyage ivyo atunze atabanje kumuboha. Aho ni ho honyene ashobora kwinjira mu nzu akamunyaga ivyiwe.
Ndababwire ukuri, ivyaha vyose abana b’abantu bakora n’ibitutsi vyose batuka Imana barashobora kubibabarirwa.
Ariko umuntu wese atuka Mpwemu Yera ntazokwigera abiharirwa, icaha ciwe kizohoraho ibihe bidashira.”
Ivyo yabivuze kuko bariko bavuga ngo arimwo impwemu mbi.
Nyina wa Yesu na bene nyina baraza bahagarara hanze, batuma umuntu kumuhamagara.
Abantu bari bamukikije baramubwira bati: “Nyoko na bene nyoko bari hanze kandi barakurondera.”
Arababaza ati: “Mama ni nde kandi bene mama ni ba nde?”
Nuko yihweza abari bamukikije, avuga ati: “Aba ni bo mama kandi ni bo bene mama.
Uwukora ivyo Imana ishaka wese ni we mwene mama kandi ni we mama.”

headings.text: Yesu akiza umuntu ku musi w’Isabato
Yesu atoranya abigishwa cumi na babiri
Nyina na bene nyina ba Yesu

verses.text: Ikindi gihe Yesu asubira kwigishiriza ku nkengera y’ikiyaga c’i Galilaya, maze abantu isinzi bakoranira aho ari, na we aca atambukira mu bwato abwicaramwo, abantu na bo bahagarara i musozi.
Nuko abigisha vyinshi mu migani, ababwira ati:
“Umviriza! Habaye umurimyi yasohoye imbuto ziwe aja kubiba.
Ariko arabiba, zimwe zigwa i ruhande y’inzira, hanyuma inyoni ziraza zirazinobagura.
Izindi zigwa ku rutare, ahantu hatagira ivu ryinshi; zica zimera ningoga kuko ivu ryari rike.
Ariko izuba ryatse, za mbuto zica ziruma kuko imizi yazo itashika kure.
Izindi mbuto zigwa mu mahwa; zimaze kumera, ayo mahwa arakura arazinyoha, ntizashobora kwama.
Ariko hari n’imbuto zaguye mw’ivu ryiza. Izo zarameze, zirakura kandi zirama; zimwe zama mirongo itatu, izindi mirongo itandatu, izindi ijana.”
Hanyuma aca ababwira ati: “Uwufise amatwi yumva, niyumve!”
Inyuma y’aho, Yesu ari kumwe na bamwe cumi na babiri n’abandi bari bamukikije, bamubaza ivyerekeye iyo migani.
Arabishura ati: “Mwebwe mwahawe kumenya amabanga y’ivy’Ubwami bw’Imana. Ariko ku bandi bo hanze, nkoresha imigani
kugira ngo, ‘naho boraba, ntibabone, naho bokwumviriza ntibatahure; kugira ngo ntibagaruke ku Mana na yo ngo ibababarire.’ ”
Nuko Yesu arababaza ati: “Mbega ntimutahura uwo mugani? None iyindi mwoyitahura gute?
Umubivyi abiba ijambo ry’Imana.
Abantu bamwe bafise imitima imeze nk’i ruhande y’inzira. Bagiheza kwumva iryo jambo, Satani araza agakura iryo jambo ritewe mu mitima yabo.
Abandi, imitima yabo imeze nk’urutare. Abo ni abumva ijambo ry’Imana bakaryakirana umunezero.
Ariko kubera iryo jambo ritagira imizi muri bo, bamara akanya gato bizeye. Iyo baciye mu vyago canke mu guhamwa kubw’iryo jambo ry’Imana, baca bata ukwizera.
Abandi bafise imitima imeze nk’umurima urimwo amahwa. Abo barumva ijambo ry’Imana,
ariko imyitwarariko y’ivy’iyi si, n’uruhendo rw’ubutunzi n’ibindi vyipfuzo vy’uburyo bwinshi, biraza bikanyoha iryo jambo bigatuma ata co ryama.
Abandi imitima yabo imeze nk’umurima ufise ivu ryiza. Abo na bo ni abumva ijambo ry’Imana bakaryakira maze bakama ivyamwa, bamwe mirongo itatu, abandi mirongo itandatu, abandi ijana.”
Yesu yongera kubabwira ati: “Mbega hari umuntu yodomeka itara akaryubikako igiseke canke akarishira musi y’igitanda? Mbega ntibarishira aho risanzwe riterekwa?
Nta canyegejwe kitazoshirwa ahabona, kandi nta cagizwe ibanga kitazomenyekana.
Uwufise amatwi yumva, niyumve!”
Yongera kubabwira ati: “Mubanze mwitondere cane ivyo mwumva! Kuko uko mugerera abandi ari ko namwe muzogererwa, mbere birushirije.
Uwufise azokwongererezwa, uwudafise azokwakwa n’ivyo yari afise.”
Yesu yongera kubabwira ati: “Uku ni ko Ubwami bw’Imana bugereranywa: Iyo umuntu abivye imbuto mu murima wiwe,
haba mw’ijoro canke ku murango, asinziriye canke ari maso, izo mbuto ziramera, zigakura, ariko we ntamenya uko bigenda.
Isi ubwayo ni yo ituma icabibwe gikura kandi kikama: ubwa mbere haza umutumba waco, hagakurikira umuyange, hanyuma intete.
Umurima weze, wa murimyi arazana umuhoro akimbura, kuko iyimbura riba rigeze.”
Yesu yongera kuvuga ati: “Mbega Ubwami bw’Imana twobugereranya n’iki? Twokoresha uwuhe mugani mu kubusigura?
Ubwami bw’Imana busa n’akabuto k’igiterwa citwa mutaride. Ako kabuto ni gato kurusha izindi zose zo kw’isi.
Ariko iyo gatewe, karakura kakaba igiti kiruta ibindi vyose. Amashami yaco arakura, akaba manini kugeza n’aho inyoni ziza zikarika mu gitutu caco.”
Yesu yigisha abantu akoresheje imigani myinshi isa n’iyo, akurikije ivyo bashobora gutahura.
Nta kintu na kimwe yabigishije adakoresheje imigani. Ariko asigaranye n’abigishwa biwe bonyene, yaca abasigurira vyose.
Ku mugoroba w’uwo musi nyene, Yesu abwira abigishwa biwe ati: “Tujabuke tuje hakurya y’ikiyaga.”
Nuko basiga aho rya sinzi ry’abantu, baja mu bwato Yesu yari yicayemwo, bajana na we. Kandi hari n’ubundi bwato bwajanye n’ubwabo.
Maze haza umuyaga w’igihuhusi ukomeye bituma imipfunda y’amazi yisuka mu bwato, ku buryo bwari bugiye kwuzura amazi.
Yesu we yari aryamye inyuma mu bwato, yiseguye yisinziririye. Abigishwa baramukangura, bamubwira bati: “Mwigisha, nta co bikubwiye ko tugira twicwe n’amazi?”
Nuko Yesu aravyuka, akankamira uwo muyaga, abwira ikiyaga ati: “Hora, tekereza!” Wa muyaga uca urahagarara, haba agahwekere.
Aca abwira abigishwa biwe ati: “Ni kuki mufise ubwoba? Mbega n’ubu nta kwizera mugira?”
Ba bigishwa baratinya cane, barabazanya bati: “Mbega uwu ni umuntu ki, ko umuyaga n’imipfunda na vyo bimwumvira?”
Nuko bashika hakurya y’ikiyaga c’i Galilaya, mu ntara ya Gerasene.
Yesu avuye mu bwato, umuntu arimwo impwemu mbi aza guhura na we avuye mu mva.
Uwo muntu yaba mw’itongo ry’abapfuye kandi nta muntu yashobora kumuboha, naho yokoresheje iminyororo.
Kuko kenshi bamubohesha iminyororo ku maboko n’ivyuma ku maguru, ariko iyo minyororo yarayicagagura, n’ivyo vyuma akabivunagura. Nta muntu n’umwe yashobora kumutururuza.
Uko bukeye, uko bwije, yagendagenda mu mva no ku misozi aboroga kandi yikomeretsa n’amabuye akarishe.
Uwo muntu abonye Yesu akiri kure, ariruka apfukama imbere yiwe.
Arasemerera n’ijwi rirenga ati: “Mbega undonderako iki ga Yesu, Mwana w’Imana Musumbavyose? Ndakwinginze mw’izina ry’Imana ntunkubagure!”
Ivyo yabivuze kuko Yesu yari ahejeje kuyibwira ati: “Wa mpwemu mbi we, muvemwo!”
Yesu arayibaza ati: “Witwa nde?” Na yo iramwishura iti: “Nitwa Gitero, kuko turi benshi.”
Nuko za mpwemu mbi zinginga Yesu zishimitse ngo ntazirukane muri iyo ntara.
Hafi y’aho, hari umukuku w’ingurube zari ziragiwe ku musozi.
Abo badayimoni binginga Yesu bati: “Twemerere uturungike muri ziriya ngurube, tuzinjiremwo.”

Nuko Yesu arazemerera. Izo mpwemu mbi ziva muri wa muntu zinjira muri za ngurube. Izo ngurube zashika nk’ibihumbi bibiri. Nuko ziva kuri wa musozi ziruka zimanuka zisuka mu kiyaga ziradwibira, zicwa n’amazi.
Abari baziragiye baca barahunga, baja kubivuga mu gisagara co hafi y’aho no mu misozi ihegereye. Nuko abantu barakorana baza kuraba ivyabaye.
Bashitse aho Yesu ari, babona wa muntu yari yaraboshwe n’abadayimoni benshi yicaye, yambaye kandi afise ubwenge bukwiye, maze bagira ubwoba.
Ababonye uko vyagenze baca babiganira ivyabaye kuri wa muntu yari aboshwe n’abadayimoni no kuri za ngurube.
Maze abo bantu binginga Yesu ngo abavire mu ntara.
Yesu ariko arurira mu bwato, wa muntu yari yaraboshwe n’abadayimoni aramwinginga ngo bajane.
Ariko Yesu ntiyamwemerera, ahubwo amubwira ati: “Subira i muhira mu muryango wawe, ubabwire ivyo Umwami Imana yagukoreye vyose, n’ingene yakugiriye imbabazi.”
Wa muntu aca arataha ageze i Dekapolisi, atangura kuvuga ivyo Yesu yamukoreye. Abantu bose bavyumvise baratangara cane.
Yesu amaze kujabuka agasubira hakurya y’ikiyaga, abantu isinzi baraza bakoranira hafi y’ikiyaga aho yari ari.
Maze haza umwe mu bakuru b’isinagogi, yitwa Yayiro. Abonye Yesu, apfukama imbere yiwe,
aramutakambira ati: “Umukobwa wanje ari ku mpfiro. Ndakwinginze uze umurambikeko ibiganza akire abe muzima.”
Nuko Yesu ajana na we. Kandi hari abantu benshi bari bamukurikiye, bamubanda.
Muri bo harimwo n’umugore yari amaze imyaka cumi n’ibiri agwaye ingwara yo mu gitereko yo kuva amaraso.
Yari yarivuje ku baganga benshi kandi atanga ivyo yari afise vyose, ariko aho gukira abandanya aremba.
Yumvise inkuru za Yesu, araza amuturuka inyuma, aca muri rya sinzi ry’abantu, akora ku mpuzu yiwe,
kuko yibwira ati: “Naho nokora ku mpuzu yiwe gusa, nokira.”
Ubwo nyene kwa kuva amaraso kurahagarara, yumva mu mubiri wiwe ko akize ingwara yiwe.
Ako kanya nyene Yesu yumva ko hari ubushobozi bumuvuyemwo. Ahindukirira rya sinzi ry’abantu, arababaza ati: “Ni nde akoze ku mpuzu zanje?”
Abigishwa biwe baramwishura bati: “Abantu bariko barakubanda impande zose, none uriko ubaza ngo: ‘Ni nde ankozeko?’ ”
Ariko Yesu abandanya araba hirya no hino kugira ngo arabe ko yobona uwamukozeko.
Wa mugore, kuko yari azi ivyamubayeko, aza ajugumira kubera ubwoba, apfukama imbere y’ibirenge vya Yesu, amubwira ukuri kwose.
Yesu aramubwira ati: “Mwana wanje, ukwizera kwawe kuragukijije, igire amahoro kandi ukire icago cawe.”
Yesu akiriko aravuga, haza abantu bavuye kwa Yayiro, wa mukuru w’isinagogi, bamubwira bati: “Umukobwa wawe yamaze gucikana. Ni kuki ubandanya ugora umwigisha?”
Yesu yumvise ivyo bavuze, aca abwira Yayiro ati: “Ntutinye, wizere gusa.”
Ntiyemerera umuntu n’umwe kumukurikira kiretse Petero, Yakobo na Yohana mwene nyina wa Yakobo.
Bashitse i muhira kwa wa mukuru w’isinagogi, Yesu ahasanga urwamo rwinshi, abantu barira, abandi na bo bakoma induru n’ijwi rirenga.
Nuko arinjira, ababwira ati: “Ni kuki hari induru n’amarira? Umwana ntiyapfuye, arasinziriye.”
Ba bantu baramutwenga. Amaze kubasohora bose, yinjirana na se na nyina b’umwana hamwe na ba bigishwa bari kumwe na we, baja aho umwana ari.
Amufata ukuboko amubwira ati: \+wj “Talita kumi!”\+wj* bisigura ngo: “Gakobwa, ndakubwiye nti vyuka!”
Ako kanya wa mukobwa arahaguruka atangura kugendagenda; yari afise nk’imyaka cumi n’ibiri. Babonye ibibaye, bose baratangara cane.
Maze Yesu arabihanikiriza ngo ntihagire umuntu n’umwe babwira ivyabaye, yongera ababwira ngo bagaburire uwo mwana.

headings.text: Yesu akiza umuntu arimwo impwemu mbi
Yesu azura umwana, akiza n’umugore agwaye

verses.text: Nuko Yesu ava ngaho aja i Nazareti, igisagara yakuriyemwo, ajanye n’abigishwa biwe.

Umusi w’Isabato ushitse, atangura kwigisha mw’isinagogi; benshi bamwumvirije baratangara cane. Barabazanya bati: “Mbega ivyo yigisha yabikuye he? Ubwo bwenge n’ubwo bushobozi bwo gukora ibitangaza yabikuye he?
Mbega uwu si wa mubaji? Nyina si Mariya, abo bavukana si Yakobo, Yosefu, Yuda na Simoni? Bashiki biwe si ababanyi bacu?” Maze ivyo birabatsitaza, bituma batamwizera.
Yesu arababwira ati: “Uwuvugishwa n’Imana arubahwa hose kiretse iwabo no mu muryango wiwe.”
Nta gitangaza yahakoreye kiretse abantu bake yarambitseko ibiganza, akabasengera bagakira.
Maze atangazwa cane n’ukutizera kwabo.
Ahamagara bamwe cumi na babiri, abarungika ari babiribabiri, abaha ububasha bwo kwirukana impwemu zihumanye.
Ababwira abihanikiriza ati: “Ntihagire ikintu na kimwe mujana ku rugendo kiretse inkoni yo kwishimikiza. Ntimujane ivyokurya, amasakoshi, canke amahera mu mifuko yanyu.
Mwambare ibirato kandi ntihagire impuzu zo gukuranya mutwara.
Inzu muzokwinjiramwo bakabakira, muze muyigumemwo kugeza muvuye aho hantu.
Nimwaja ahantu bakanka kubakira canke kubumviriza, muze mukunkumure umukungugu wo mu birenge vyanyu, muhave. Ico kizobabera ikimenyetso co kubagiriza.”
Nuko baragenda bigisha abantu ivyo kwihana;
birukana abadayimoni benshi kandi basiga amavuta abagwaye benshi, barabasengera barakira.
Muri iyo misi, Umwami Herode Antipa yumva inkuru za Yesu kuko yari yamaze kumenyekana cane. Bamwe bavuga bati: “Yohana Umubatizi yazutse, ni co gituma afise ubushobozi bwo gukora ibitangaza.”
Abandi bavuga bati: “Ni Eliya.” Hakaba n’abandi bavuga bati: “Ni uwuvugishwa n’Imana, asa n’umwe mu bavugishwa n’Imana ba kera.”
Ariko Herode avyumvise aravuga ati: “Ko Yohana ari jewe namuciye umutwe, yoba yazutse!”

Herode Antipa ubwiwe ni we yari yatanze itegeko ryo gufata Yohana, kumuboha no kumuta mw’ibohero. Ivyo yabikoze abitumwe na Herodiya, uwo yari yararongoye kandi yari asanzwe ari muka Filipo, uwo bavukana.
Kuko Yohana yama abwira Herode ati: “Ntivyemewe ko urongora umugore w’uwo muvukana.”
Ivyo vyatumye Herodiya amwanka urwanko rubi, akipfuza kumwica. Ariko ntiyabishobora,
kuko Herode yatinya Yohana akamukingira. Yari amuzi nk’umuntu w’umugororotsi kandi w’intungane. Igihe cose yamwumviriza, ivyiwe vyaramubuza amahoro, ariko kandi agakunda kumwumviriza.

Maze igihe kimwe Herodiya aronka akaryo. Ku musi mukuru wo kwibuka ivuka rya Herode, umwami yateguye umusi mukuru atumira abategetsi bakurubakuru bo ku ngoma yiwe, intwazangabo hamwe n’abatware bo mu ntara ya Galilaya.
Maze umukobwa wa Herodiya araza aratamba, anezereza cane Herode n’abatumire biwe. Umwami aca abwira uwo mukobwa ati: “Nsaba ico ushaka cose, ndakiguha.”
Ivyo yabimwemereye ashizeko n’indahiro ati: “Ico unsaba cose ndakiguha, naho coba igice c’ubwami bwanje.”
Wa mukobwa arasohoka abaza nyina ati: “Nsabe iki?” Na we aramwishura ati: “Saba umutwe wa Yohana Umubatizi!”
Ubwo nyene wa mukobwa ariruka asubira aho umwami ari, aramubwira ati: “Nsavye ko umpa ubu nyene umutwe wa Yohana Umubatizi kw’isiniya!”
Maze umwami Herode arababara cane, ariko kubera indahiro yarahiye imbere y’abatumire, ntiyashobora kumwankira ico asavye.
Nuko aca arungika umusoda amutegeka kuzana umutwe wa Yohana. Wa musoda aja mw’ibohero, aca umutwe Yohana,
agaruka awuzanye kw’isiniya, awuha wa mukobwa na we awuha nyina.
Abigishwa ba Yohana bavyumvise baraza batora ikiziga ciwe baja kugihamba.
Intumwa zigarutse zikoranira aho Yesu ari, zimwiganira ivyo zakoze n’ivyo zigishije.
Kubera hari uruja n’uruza rw’abantu benshi ku buryo batashobora no kuronka akaryo ko gufungura, Yesu aca ababwira ati: “Nimuze tuje mu kibanza gitekanye, turuhuke.”
Nuko bafata ubwato baja ahantu hiherereye.
Ariko benshi bababona bakiva aho hantu, barabamenya, baca bava mu bisagara vyose bariruka n’amaguru, babatangayo.
Yesu amaze kuva mu bwato abona abantu benshi, bamutera akagongwe, kuko bari bameze nk’intama zitagira umwungere. Nuko atangura kubigisha vyinshi.
Bumaze kwira, abigishwa biwe baza aho ari, bamubwira bati: “Aha hantu turi ni mu gahinga kandi buriko burira.
Rungika aba bantu baje mu misozi no mu mihana yo hafi kugira ngo bigurire ivyo barya.”
Yesu arabishura ati: “Nimubagaburire mwebwe nyene.” Na bo baramubwira bati: “Mbega twokura hehe idenariyo amajana abiri zo kugura ivyokurya bikwiye aba bantu?”
Yesu arababaza ati: “Mufise imikate ingahe? Genda murabe.” Bagarutse bamubwira bati: “Dufise imikate itanu n’ifi zibiri.”
Nuko abatuma kwicarika abantu mu migwi ahantu hari ubwatsi butotahaye.
Bicara mu migwi y’abantu ijanijana na mirongo itanu itanu.
Yesu afata ya mikate itanu na za fi zibiri, araba mw’ijuru, abishimira Imana. Hanyuma amanyagura ya mikate, ayihereza abigishwa ngo bayigaburire abantu. Abagaburira na za fi bose uko bangana.
Nuko bose bararya kandi barahaga.
Hanyuma abigishwa begeranya ibiseke cumi na bibiri vy’ivyasigaye kuri ya mikate na za fi.
Abariye bari abagabo ibihumbi bitanu.
Hanyuma y’ivyo, Yesu abwira abigishwa biwe ngo baje mu bwato babe baragenda bamwitangire imbere mu kujabuka i Betesayida; na we asigare arasezera abantu.
Ahejeje kubasezera, aca aduga umusozi gusenga.
Bumaze kwira, bwa bwato bwari bugeze hagati mu kiyaga, Yesu we yari akiri ku musozi ari wenyene.
Akiri ngaho, abona ko abigishwa biwe bafise ingorane nyinshi mu gusoza kuko umuyaga waza ubaturutse imbere. Ijoro rigeze kure bugiye guca, aza aho bari, agendera ku mazi, asa n’uwugira abarengane.
Bamubonye agendera ku mazi, bagira ngo ni umuzimu, baca bakoma induru,
kuko bose bari bagize ubwoba bwinshi. Aca arababwira ati: “Humura! Ni jewe. Ntimugire ubwoba.”
Nuko atambukira mu bwato maze umuyaga uca urahagarara. Na bo baratangara cane,
kuko na ca gitangaza c’imikate batari bwagitahure, bitumwe n’uko imitima yabo yari ikomantajwe n’ukutizera.
Bamaze kujabuka, bashika hakurya ahitwa Genezareti, bazirikira ubwato i musozi.
Bururutse ubwato, abantu barababona, bamenyamwo Yesu.
Baca bakwiragira muri ako karere kose bazana abantu bagwaye ku nderuzo, babajana aho bumvise ko Yesu ari hose.

Kandi aho yaja hose, haba mu mihana, mu bisagara canke mu misozi, abantu bazana abagwaye babo bakabashira ahabona, maze bakamwinginga ngo abareke bakore ku musozo w’impuzu yiwe, kandi abawukorako bose baca bakira.

headings.text: Yesu arungika abigishwa biwe cumi na babiri Nuko Yesu agendagenda yigisha, ava mu mihana aja mu yindi.

verses.text: Abafarisayo na bamwe mu bigisha b’ivyagezwe bari bavuye i Yerusalemu baragenda bakoranira aho Yesu ari,
maze babona bamwe mu bigishwa biwe bafungura kandi amaboko yabo ahumanye, ni ukuvuga batakaravye nk’uko umugenzo wabitegeka.
Mu bisanzwe, Abafarisayo n’abandi Bayuda ntibashobora gufungura batabanje gukaraba nk’uko umugenzo wa ba sekuru wabitegeka.
Kandi n’iyo bavuye kw’isoko, ntibashobora gufungura batabanje gukaraba. Barakurikiza n’iyindi migenzo, nko kwoza ibikombe, amasafuriya, amasahani n’imeza.
Nuko ba Bafarisayo na ba bigisha b’ivyagezwe babaza Yesu bati: “Ni kuki abigishwa bawe batubahiriza imigenzo ya ba sogokuruza, bagafungura n’iminwe ihumanye?”
Arabishura ati: “Yesaya yavuze ukuri igihe yabavugishwako mwa ndyarya mwe! Yanditse avuga ati: ‘Aba bantu banyubahisha iminwa yabo, ariko imitima yabo iri kure yanje.
Ukunsenga kwabo ntikugira ikimazi; inyigisho zabo ni amabwirizwa abantu bishingiye.’
Mureka amabwirizwa y’Imana mugashira imitima ku migenzo y’abantu.”
Yongera arababwira ati: “Mwagize ishaka ryo kutubahiriza amabwirizwa y’Imana kugira ngo mwubahirize imigenzo yanyu!
Kuko Mose yavuze ati: ‘Wubahe so na nyoko,’ yongerako ati: ‘Umuntu wese azovuma se canke nyina, aze yicwe.’
Ariko mweho muvuga ko iyo umuntu afise ico yari gufashisha se canke nyina, ariko akavuga ko ari Korobani; bisigura ko cagizwe inyegu y’Imana,
ko ivyo bituma mumwemerera kutagira ico afashisha se canke nyina.
Uko ni ko muhindura ijambo ry’Imana ubusa mwishimikije imigenzo mwishingiye kandi mugakora n’ibindi vyinshi bisa n’ivyo.”
Hanyuma Yesu yongera guhamagara rya sinzi ry’abantu ngo begere aho ari, maze arababwira ati: “Nimuntege amatwi mwese, kandi mutahure:
Nta kintu na kimwe kija mu muntu kivuye hanze gishobora kumuhumanya; ahubwo igihumanya umuntu ni ikiva muri we. [
Uwufise amatwi yumva, niyumve.” ]
Yesu amaze kuva aho abantu bari akaja mu nzu, abigishwa biwe bamusaba ngo abasigurire uwo mugani.
Arababaza ati: “Mbega namwe ntimutahura? Ntimuzi ko ico umuntu arya kidashobora kumuhumanya?
Kuko ntikija mu mutima wiwe, ahubwo kija mu nda yiwe, hanyuma kigasohoka.” Mu kuvuga ibi, Yesu yariko yerekana ko ata vyokurya bihumanya.
Arongerako ati: “Ibiva mu muntu ni vyo bimuhumanya.
Kuko imbere mu mutima w’umuntu ari ho hava ivyiyumviro bibi, ingeso mbi z’ivy’isoni nke, ubusuma, ubwicanyi,
ubusambanyi, gukunda ibintu kurenze urugero, ubukozi bw’ikibi, ubugunge, kwipfuza kurenze urugero, kwipfuza ivy’abandi, gutukana, ubwibone, n’ubupfu.
Ivyo bibi vyose biva mu muntu maze bikamuhumanya.”
Hanyuma y’ivyo Yesu ava i Galilaya aja mu karere kegereye igisagara ca Tiro. Nuko yinjira mu nzu kandi ntiyashaka ko hagira uwumenya ko ari ho ari; ariko ntivyakunda ko yihisha.
Ubwo nyene umugore yari afise umukobwa aboshwe n’impwemu mbi yumva ko Yesu ari ho ari. Aca araza yikubita imbere y’ibirenge vyiwe.
Uwo mugore yari Umugirikikazi yavukiye i Foyinike muri Siriya. Nuko yinginga Yesu ngo yirukane impwemu mbi yari mu mukobwa wiwe.
Yesu aramubwira ati: “Reka abana babanze barye bahage, kuko si vyiza gufata ivyokurya vy’abana ukabiterera utubwa.”
Na we aramwishura ati: “Mwami, n’utubwa na two turarya utwo abana bakororeye musi y’imeza.”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Ko wishuye uko, niwitahire; ya mpwemu mbi yavuye mu mukobwa wawe.”
Nuko arataha asanga umwana wiwe aryamye ku buriri, ya mpwemu mbi yamuvuyemwo.
Hanyuma Yesu ava mu karere kegereye igisagara ca Tiro aca i Sidoni imbere yo gusubira ku Kiyaga c’i Galilaya no mu karere ka Dekapolisi.
Ahashitse bamuzanira umuntu atumva kandi adatobora neza, binginga Yesu ngo amurambikeko ibiganza amukize.
Nuko Yesu aramufata, amwigiza kure y’abantu, ashira intoke ziwe mu matwi y’uwo muntu, acira amate ku ntoke ziwe maze amukora ku rurimi.
Ahanga amaso mw’ijuru, ariruhutsa, maze abwira wa muntu ati: \+wj “Efata!”\+wj* bisigura ngo: “Zibuka” .
Ubwo nyene amatwi ya wa muntu arazibuka, ururimi rwiwe ruragoboroka, aca atangura kuvuga neza.
Yesu ategeka abari aho kutabibwira umuntu n’umwe. Ariko uko yababuza ni ko barushiriza kubikwiragiza.
Abantu baratangara cane, bituma baguma bavuga bati: “Ivyo akora vyose biratangaje. Atuma n’ibipfamatwi vyumva, n’ibiragi bikavuga.”

headings.text: Yesu ashima ukwizera kw’umugore w’i Foyinike
Yesu akiza umuntu atumva kandi atavuga

verses.text: Muri iyo misi, abantu benshi bongera gukorana, kandi nta vyokurya bari bagisigaranye. Yesu ahamagara abigishwa biwe arababwira ati:
“Aba bantu banteye ikigongwe. Tumaranye imisi itatu none raba nta vyokurya bafise.
Ninabarungika bashonje, bahava bagwira isari mu nzira, kuko bamwe muri bo bavuye kure.”
Abigishwa baramwishura bati: “None twokura hehe ivyokurya vyokwira aba bantu muri ubu bugaragwa?”
Yesu arababaza ati: “Mufise imikate ingahe?” Baramwishura bati: “Indwi.”
Maze Yesu abwira ba bantu ngo bicare hasi. Afata ya mikate, ayishimira Imana, arayimanyagura, ayiha abigishwa ngo bayihe abantu, na bo babikora uko nyene.
Bari bafise kandi n’udufi duke. Na two adushimira Imana, abwira abigishwa ngo baduhe abantu.
Ba bantu bararya barahaga. Abigishwa begeranya ibiseke indwi vyuzuye utumanyu twasigaye.
Abari aho bashika ibihumbi bine. Bahejeje kurya, Yesu aca arabarungika barataha.
Ubwo nyene aca aja mu bwato n’abigishwa biwe baja mu karere k’i Dalamanuta.
Abafarisayo bumvise ko Yesu yashitse, baraza batangura kumuhaririza. Mu ntumbero yo kumugeza, bamusaba ngo akore ikimenyetso kivuye mw’ijuru.
Maze Yesu ariruhutsa cane, hanyuma ababwira ati: “Mbega ni kuki abantu ba kino gihe basaba ikimenyetso? Ndababwire ukuri, nta kimenyetso nk’ico nzoha abo muri runo runganwe.”
Nuko aca abasiga ngaho, atambukira mu bwato aja ku rundi ruhande rw’ikiyaga.
Abigishwa bari bibagiye kuzana ivyokurya. Bari bafise umukate umwe gusa mu bwato.
Bariko barajabuka arabagabisha ati: “Mwirinde umwambiro w’Abafarisayo n’uwa Herode.”
Abigishwa baca baravugana bati: “Ivyo abivuze kuko tutagira imikate.”
Yesu yari azi ivyo bariko baravugana, ni ko kubabwira ati: “Ni kuki muvugana ku vyo kutagira imikate? N’ubu ntimurabona canke ngo mutahure? Imitima yanyu irakomantaye ku buryo idashobora gutahura?
Ko mufise amaso, ni kuki mutabona? Ko mufise amatwi, ni kuki mutumva? Nta kintu na kimwe mwibuka?
Hamwe namanyagura ya mikate itanu nkagaburira abantu ibihumbi bitanu, mwegeranije ibiseke bingahe vyuzuye utumanyu basigaje?” Baramwishura bati: “Cumi na bibiri.”
Yesu arabandanya ati: “Hamwe namanyagura ya mikate indwi nkagaburira abantu ibihumbi bine, mwegeranije ibiseke bingahe vyuzuye utumanyu basigaje?” Baramwishura bati: “Indwi.”
Maze arababaza ati: “N’ubu ntimuratahura?”
Bashitse i Betesayida, bamuzanira impumyi baramwinginga ngo amukoreko, amukize.
Nuko afata ukuboko kw’uwo ahumye amujana inyuma y’imihana. Ahejeje gucira amate ku maso y’uwo ahumye, amurambikako ibiganza, aramubaza ati: “Hari ikintu ubona?”
Wa muntu areraguza, maze avuga ati: “Egome, ndabona abantu, ariko bameze nk’ibiti bigendagenda.”
Yesu yongera kurambika ibiganza ku maso y’uwo muntu, maze amaso yiwe aca urahumuka. Aca arakira rwose, abona neza.
Maze, Yesu aca aramurungika muhira, amubwira ati: “Ntuce mu mihana.”
Hanyuma y’ivyo, Yesu n’abigishwa biwe bava i Galilaya baja mu mihana yegereye i Kayisariya mu ntara yatwarwa na Filipo. Bakigenda arababaza ati: “Mbega abantu bavuga ko ndi nde?”
Baramwishura bati: “Bamwe bavuga ko uri Yohana Umubatizi; abandi ngo uri Eliya; abandi na bo ngo uri umwe mu bavugishwa n’Imana.”
Arababaza ati: “None mweho muvuga ko ndi nde?” Petero arishura ati: “Uri Kristo.”
Yesu aca arabihanikiriza ngo ntihagire umuntu n’umwe babwira ivyiwe.

Yesu aca atangura kubigisha ababwira ko Umwana w’Umuntu ategerezwa kubabazwa mu buryo bwinshi; akankwa n’abatware, n’abaherezi bakurubakuru, n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe; kandi ko azokwicwa hanyuma akazuka ku musi ugira gatatu.
Ivyo yabivuga mu majambo atomoye. Hanyuma Petero aramwihereranya, atangura kumwamira ku vyo yari avuze.
Yesu arahindukira araba abandi bigishwa, akankamira Petero ati: “Herera inyuma yanje Satani! Ibikuraje ishinga si ivy’Imana, ni ivy’abantu.”
Nuko Yesu ahamagara abantu benshi bari ngaho hamwe n’abigishwa, ababwira ati: “Uwushaka kuba umwigishwa wanje wese, ategerezwa kwiheba, akikorera umusaraba wiwe akankurikira.
Kuko uwugomba gukiza ubugingo bwiwe, azobubura. Ariko uwubuheba ku bwanje no ku bw’Ubutumwa Bwiza, azobukiza.
Mbega umuntu vyomumarira iki yungutse ivyo mw’isi vyose, ariko agatakaza ubugingo bwiwe?
Canke umuntu yotanga iki kugira ngo acungure ubugingo bwiwe?

Umuntu niyagira isoni zo kunyemera no kwemera amajambo yanje muri uru runganwe rw’abasambanyi n’abanyavyaha, n’Umwana w’Umuntu na we azogira isoni zo kumwemera aho azozira mu bwiza bwa Se ari kumwe n’abamarayika bera.”

headings.text: Yesu agabisha abantu ku vyerekeye inyigisho mbi
Petero avuga ko Yesu ari Kristo

verses.text: Maze abandanya ababwira ati: “Ndababwire ukuri, bamwe mu bahagaze hano muri kano kanya ntibazopfa batabonye Ubwami bw’Imana buza mu bushobozi buhambaye.”
Haheze imisi itandatu, Yesu ajana Petero, Yakobo na Yohana abadugana ku musozi muremure aho bagumanye bari ukwa bonyene. Bari ngaho ishusho ya Yesu ihinduka babona.
Impuzu ziwe zirera cane, zica ibibatsi. Nta muntu n’umwe kw’isi yozimesuye ngo zere nk’uko.
Hanyuma baja babona Eliya na Mose imbere yabo baganira na Yesu.
Petero abwira Yesu ati: “Mwigisha, bitubereye vyiza kuba hano. Reka tuhashinge amahema atatu: iryawe, irya Mose, n’irya Eliya.”
Ntiyari azi ico avuga, kuko we na bagenziwe bari batekewe n’ubwoba.
Maze haza igicu kirabatwikira, hanyuma ijwi ryumvikanira muri nya gicu, rivuga riti: “Uwu ni Umwana wanje nkunda cane. Nimumwumvirize!”
Ako kanya nyene, baravye impande yabo, ntihagira uwundi babona atari Yesu gusa.
Bariko baramanuka bava kuri uwo musozi, Yesu arabihanikiriza ngo ntihagire umuntu n’umwe babwira ivyo babonye kugeza Umwana w’Umuntu azutse mu bapfuye.
Nuko babigumya nk’ibanga mu mitima, ariko kenshi bakabazanya ico yagomba kuvuga igihe yababwira ivyo “kuzuka mu bapfuye”.
Hanyuma baramubaza bati: “Ni kuki abigisha b’ivyagezwe bavuga ko Eliya ategerezwa kubanza kuza?”
Yesu arabishura ati: “Ni ukuri, Eliya ategerezwa kubanza kuza kugira ngo asubize vyose mu buryo. None ni kuki handitswe ko Umwana w’Umuntu ategerezwa kubabazwa cane akongera agasuzugurwa?
Ariko ndababwire, Eliya yaramaze kuza, kandi abantu bamukoreye ivyo bishakiye, nk’uko Ivyanditswe vyera bibivuga.”
Bagarutse aho abandi bigishwa bari, babona abantu benshi babakikije kandi bamwe mu bigisha b’ivyanditswe ni ho bari bari, baharira na bo.
Abo bantu bose babonye Yesu aserutse baratangara cane, biruka baja kumuramutsa.
Yesu arababaza ati: “Mbega muriko muharira ku biki?”
Umwe muri ba bantu arishura ati: “Mwigisha, nakuzaniye umuhungu wanje, kuko aboshwe n’impwemu mbi ituma atavuga.
Ishobora kumufatira aho ari hose, ikamutura hasi, akabira ifuro mu kanwa, agahekenya amenyo, hanyuma umubiri wiwe ukadadarara.”
Yesu arabishura ati: “Mwa bantu b’iki gihe, ata kwizera mufise! Mbega nkwiye kugumana namwe igihe kingana gute? Mbega nzobihanganira gushika ryari? Nimunzanire uwo mwana.”
Nuko bamuzanira uwo mwana. Ya mpwemu mbi ikibona Yesu, itangura kumujegeza cane, agwa hasi, arikumbagaza, abira ifuro mu kanwa.
Yesu abaza se w’uwo mwana ati: “Ibi vyatanguye kumushikira ryari?” Na we arishura ati: “Kuva akiri umwana muto cane.
Kenshi iyo mpwemu imuta mu muriro canke mu mazi, ikagerageza kumwica. Nimba woshobora kugira ico ukoze, utugirire impuhwe udufashe.”
Yesu aravuga ati: “Uvuze uti: ‘Nimba noshobora kugira ico nkoze’? Vyose bishobokera uwizera.”
Ubwo nyene se w’uwo mwana arasemerera ati: “Ndizera! Ariko mfasha neshe ukutizera kwanje!”
Yesu abonye ko abantu benshi baje biruka batumbereye aho bari, ategeka ya mpwemu ihumanye ati: “Wa mpwemu itera uburagi n’ukutumva, va muri uwu mwana kandi ntuze wongere kumugarukamwo.”
Ya mpwemu ihumanye ivuza induru, ijegeza cane wa mwana, hanyuma imuvamwo. Uwo mwana aca amera nk’uwupfuye, kandi benshi bavuga bati: “Arapfuye.”
Ariko Yesu amufata ukuboko aramuhagurutsa, maze wa mwana arahagarara.
Mu nyuma y’ivyo, Yesu yinjiye mu nzu, abigishwa biwe baramubaza biherereye bati: “Ni kuki twebwe vyatunaniye kwirukana irya dayimoni?”
Arabishura ati: “Ugusenga kwonyene ni kwo gushobora kwirukana impwemu nk’irya.”
Nuko bava aho hantu baca i Galilaya. Yesu ntiyashaka ko hagira uwumenya aho bari,
kuko yashaka kugumana n’abigishwa biwe ngo abigishe. Arababwira ati: “Umwana w’Umuntu agiye gutabwa mu maboko y’abantu. Bazomwica ariko ku musi ugira gatatu, azozuka.”
Ariko ntibatahura ico ababwiye, kandi batinya no kugira ico babimubazako.
Nuko bashika i Kaperinawumu. Ashitse mu nzu abaza abigishwa biwe ati: “Mbega mwariko muharira ku biki igihe twari mu nzira tuza?”
Ariko ntibamwishura, kuko mu nzira bariko babazanya umukuru muri bo uwo ari we.
Yesu amaze kwicara ahamagara bamwe cumi na babiri arababwira ati: “Umuntu wese ashaka kuba uwa mbere ategerezwa kuba uw’inyuma ya bose, n’umukozi wa bose.”
Nuko afata umwana mutoya amuhagarika hagati yabo, aramuterura, ababwira ati:
“Umuntu wese yakira umwe muri aba bana bato mw’izina ryanje aba anyakiriye; kandi uwunyakiriye wese ntaba yakiriye jewe gusa, ahubwo aba yakiriye n’uwantumye.”
Yohana abwira Yesu ati: “Mwigisha, twabonye umuntu yirukana abadayimoni mw’izina ryawe duca turamubuza kuko atari uwo muri twebwe.”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Ntimukamubuze, kuko nta muntu yokora igitangaza mw’izina ryanje hanyuma ngo agaruke amvuge nabi.
Kuko uwutatugwanya aba ari ku ruhande rwacu.
Ndababwire ukuri, umuntu wese abahaye igikombe c’amazi mw’izina ryanje kuko muri aba Kristo, ntazobura kubihererwa impera.
Nihagira umuntu atuma umwe muri aba bato banyizera acumura, ikimukwiye ni uko yoboherwa urusyo kw’izosi, agatererwa mu kiyaga.
Ukuboko kwawe nikwagutuma gucumura, nuguce. Vyokubera vyiza kwinjira mu bugingo budashira ufise ukuboko kumwe, hako winjira mu muriro utazima wa Gehinomu ufise amaboko yompi, [
aho ‘inyo zaho zidapfa, n’umuriro waho utazima.’ ]
Kandi ukuguru kwawe nikwagutuma gukora icaha, nuguce. Vyokubera vyiza kwinjira mu bugingo budashira ufise ukuguru kumwe, hako winjira mu muriro utazima wa Gehinomu ufise amaguru yompi, [
aho ‘inyo zaho zidapfa, n’umuriro waho utazima.’ ]
Ijisho ryawe niryatuma ukora icaha, rinogore, urite kure. Vyokubera vyiza kwinjira mu Bwami bw’Imana ufise ijisho rimwe, hako utererwa muri Gehinomu ufise amaso yompi,
aho ‘inyo zaho ntizipfa, n’umuriro waho ntuzima.’
Umuntu wese azosuzumwa n’umuriro.
Umunyu ni ngirakamaro. Ariko iyo utakaje uburyohe bwawo, mbega bwosubiramwo gute? Mugire uburyohe nka kurya kw’umunyu muri mwebwe kandi mubane amahoro.”

headings.text: Yesu akiza umuhungu arimwo impwemu mbi
Yesu asubira kuvuga ibijanye n’urupfu rwiwe
Uwutatugwanya aba ari ku ruhande rwacu

verses.text: Nuko Yesu ava i Kaperinawumu aja mu ntara ya Yudaya, hakurya y’uruzi Yorodani. Na ho nyene abantu benshi baragenda aho ari, aca arabigisha nk’uko yamenyereye.
Bamwe mu Bafarisayo baraza bagerageza kumutega umutego, baramubaza bati: “Mbega biremewe ko umugabo yahukana n’umugore wiwe?”
Arabishura ati: “Mbega ivyagezwe vya Mose bitegeka iki?”
Baramwishura bati: “Mose yaremeye ko umuntu ashobora guha umugore wiwe urwandiko rwemeza ko bahukanye hanyuma akamwirukana.”
Yesu arabishura ati: “Yanditse ico cagezwe kuko imitima yanyu ikomantaye.
Ariko Imana yaremye ‘umugabo n’umugore kuva mu ntango y’irema.’
‘Ni co gituma umugabo azosiga se na nyina akabana n’umugore wiwe,
maze bakaba umubiri umwe’ ; kuko baba batakiri babiri, ahubwo baba babaye umubiri umwe.
None rero ico Imana yamatanije, ntihakagire uwukimatanura.”
Bashitse mu nzu, abigishwa basubira kubaza Yesu ku bijanye n’ukwahukana.
Arabishura ati: “Umuntu wese yirukana umugore wiwe akarongora uwundi, aba asambanye, kandi aba acumuye kuri uwo wa mbere.
Kandi iyo umugore yahukanye n’umugabo wiwe akarongorwa n’uwundi mugabo, na we nyene aba asambanye.”
Umusi umwe, abavyeyi bazanye abana babo aho Yesu ari kugira ngo abarambikeko ibiganza. Ariko abigishwa barabakankamira.
Yesu abibonye, arababara. Abwira abigishwa biwe ati: “Nimureke abana bato baze aho ndi, ntimubabuze, kuko Ubwami bw’Imana ari ubw’abameze nka bo.
Ndababwire ukuri, umuntu wese atakira Ubwami bw’Imana nk’umwana muto ntazokwigera abwinjiramwo.”
Nuko aterura ba bana, abarambikako ibiganza, arabahezagira.
Yesu afashe urugendo rwiwe aja i Yerusalemu, haza umuntu yiruka aja iyo ari, apfukama imbere yiwe, aramubaza ati: “Mwigisha mwiza, nokora iki kugira ngo nze ndagwe ubugingo budashira?”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Unyitira iki mwiza? Nta mwiza ahari, kiretse Imana yonyene.
Urazi ko amabwirizwa avuga ngo: ‘Ntukice, ntugasambane, ntukibe, ntukagirize abandi ibinyoma, ntukibe, wubahe so na nyoko.’ ”
Wa muntu yishura ati: “Ayo yose nayakurikije kuva nkiri muto.”

Yesu aramuraba yumva aramukunze. Aramubwira ati: “Hari ikintu kimwe ugihajije. Genda ugurishe ivyo utunze vyose, maze amahera ukuyemwo uyahe aboro; ni ho uzoronka ubutunzi mw’ijuru, hanyuma uze unkurikire.”
Wa muntu avyumvise aca arijirirwa, agenda ababaye kuko yari afise ubutunzi bwinshi cane.
Yesu arahindukira abwira abigishwa biwe ati: “Biragoye cane ko abatunzi binjira mu Bwami bw’Imana!”
Abigishwa batangazwa n’ayo majambo. Yesu arongera arababwira ati: “Bana nkunda, biragoye cane kwinjira mu Bwami bw’Imana!
Vyokworoha ko ingamiya ica mu gatoboro k’urushinge rwo kubarira kurusha ko umutunzi yinjira mu Bwami bw’Imana.”
Ivyo vyarushirije gutangaza abigishwa, maze baravugana bati: “None ni nde ashobora gukizwa?”
Yesu arabitegereza, hanyuma ababwira ati: “Ku bantu, ntibishoboka; ariko ku Mana, vyose birashoboka.”
Maze Petero aramubwira ati: “Twebwe twasize vyose turagukurikira!”
Yesu na we arabishura ati: “Ndababwire ukuri, nta muntu n’umwe yasize inzu, abavukanyi, se canke nyina, abana canke amatongo yiwe kubera Ubutumwa Bwiza,
atazobishumbushwa incuro ijana muri iki gihe: inzu, abavukanyi, abavyeyi, abana n’amatongo, hamwe no guhamwa. Kandi mu gihe kizoza akazoronka ubugingo budashira.
Ariko benshi mu bari imbere bazoba ab’inyuma, abari inyuma na bo bazoba ab’imbere.”

Bari mu nzira baduga i Yerusalemu, Yesu agendera imbere y’abigishwa biwe kandi bari bahagaritse imitima, ndetse n’abagendana na bo bari bafise ubwoba. Nuko Yesu yihereranya bamwe cumi na babiri, yongera kubabwira ibigiye kumubako.
Arababwira ati: “Ehe turaduze i Yerusalemu, aho Umwana w’Umuntu azotangwa agahabwa abaherezi bakurubakuru n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe. Bazomucira urubanza rwo gupfa hanyuma bamushikirize abanyamahanga,
na bo bazomucokora, bamucireko amate, bamukubite, hanyuma bamwice. Ariko inyuma y’imisi itatu azozuka.”
Yakobo na Yohana, bene Zebedayo, baza aho Yesu ari. Bamubwira bati: “Mwigisha, turakwinginze udukorere ico tugusaba.”
Arababaza ati: “Mushaka ko ndabakorera iki?”
Baramwishura bati: “Niwicara ku ntebe yawe y’ubwami mu bwiza bwawe, uze utwicarike, umwe i buryo bwawe, uwundi i bubamfu bwawe.”
Yesu arabishura ati: “Ntimuzi ico muriko murasaba! Mbega mwoshobora kunywa ku gikombe ngiye kunywako canke kubatizwa umubatizo ngiye kubatizwa?”
Baramwishura bati: “Egome twobishobora.” Yesu arababwira ati: “Ni ivy’ukuri muzonywa ku gikombe ngiye kunywerako kandi muzobatizwa umubatizo ngiye kubatizwa,
ariko ibijanye no kwicara i buryo canke i bubamfu bwanje si jewe ndabitanga. Ivyo bibanza ni ivy’ababiteguriwe.”
Bamwe cumi bandi bavyumvise bashavurira Yakobo na Yohana.
Yesu aca arabahamagara bose ababwira ati: “Murazi ko abatware b’amahanga batwaza umukazo abantu babo, kandi ko babaganza babacinyiza.
Uko si ko bikwiye kumera muri mwebwe. Uwushaka kuba mukuru muri mwebwe ategerezwa kuba umukozi wanyu,
kandi uwushaka kuba uwa mbere akwiye kuba umugurano wa bose.
Kuko n’Umwana w’Umuntu ntiyazanywe no gukorerwa, ahubwo yazanywe no gukorera abandi no gutanga ubuzima bwiwe ngo bube incungu ya benshi.”
Nuko Yesu n’abigishwa biwe bashika i Yeriko, hanyuma bava muri ico gisagara bari kumwe n’isinzi ry’abantu. I ruhande y’inzira hari impumyi yitwa Barutimayo, mwene Timayo, yari yicaye asegerereza.
Yumvise ko ari Yesu w’i Nazareti ariko ararengana, atangura gusemerera ati: “Yesu, Mwana wa Dawidi, ngirira imbabazi!”
Abantu benshi baramuzibiza bati: “Hora!” Ariko arushiriza gusemerera ati: “Mwana wa Dawidi, ngirira imbabazi!”
Yesu aca arahagarara, avuga ati: “Nimumumpamagarire.” Nuko baramuhamagara bati: “Humura! Haguruka, araguhamagaye!”
Uwo ahumye aca ata impuzu ziwe, arabaduka aja aho Yesu ari.
Yesu aramubaza ati: “Ushaka ko ngukorera iki?” Na we ati: “Mwigisha, ndashaka guhumuka.”
Yesu aca avuga ati: “Igire, ukwizera kwawe kuragukijije.” Ubwo nyene aca arahumuka, akurikira Yesu.

headings.text: Yesu avuga ubugira gatatu ivyerekeye urupfu rwiwe

verses.text: Bariko baregereza i Yerusalemu, Yesu n’abigishwa biwe bashika ahitwa Betifage n’i Betaniya ku Musozi wa Elayono. Yesu atuma babiri mu bigishwa biwe,
arababwira ati: “Nimugende muri iriya mihana iri imbere yanyu; nimwashikayo, murahasanga inyana y’indogoba iziritse ata muntu n’umwe arayigenderako. Muce muyizitura muyizane hano.
Nihagira uwubabaza ati: ‘Ivyo mukora ni ibiki?’ Mumwishure muti: ‘Umwami arayikeneye’ kandi aca ayibasubiza adatevye.”
Nuko baragenda basanga inyana y’indogoba ihagaze mu nzira, iziritse imbere y’irembo. Bariko barayizitura,
bamwe mu bantu bari bahagaze aho barababaza bati: “Ivyo mukora ni ibiki? Kuki muzitura iyo nyana y’indogoba?”
Na bo babishura nk’uko Yesu yababwiye, maze barabareka barayijana.
Nuko baca bayizanira Yesu, bayisasako impuzu zabo, na we ayicarako.
Maze abantu benshi basasa impuzu zabo mu nzira, abandi na bo basasa amashami y’ibiti baciye ku misozi.
Abari imbere ya Yesu n’abari inyuma yiwe bagenda barasemerera bavuga bati: “Hozana!” “Hahezagirwe uwuje mw’izina ry’Uhoraho!”
“Hahezagirwe ubwami bwa sogokuruza Dawidi buje!” “Hozana hejuru mw’ijuru!”
Nuko Yesu ashitse mu gisagara i Yerusalemu, aja mu rusengero. Amaze kwihweza ivy’aho, aca arasohoka asubirana i Betaniya na bamwe cumi na babiri, kuko bwari bwije.
Ku musi ukurikira, bariko baragenda bava i Betaniya, Yesu yumva arashonje.
Akiri kure abona igiti c’umusukoni gitotahaye, aca aja kuraba ko hari ivyamwa gifise. Agishikiriye ntiyagira icamwa agisangako, atari amababi kuko kitari igihe caco co kwama.
Maze abwira ico giti ati: “Ntugasubire kwama na rimwe!” Ivyo yabivuze abigishwa biwe bumva.
Yesu ashitse i Yerusalemu, yinjira mu rusengero atangura kwirukana abadandaza n’abariko barabagurira. Ahenagura imeza z’abavunja amahera hamwe n’intebe z’abadandaza inuma,
ntiyemerera umuntu n’umwe kwinjiza ibidandazwa mu rusengero.
Nuko aca arabigisha ati: “Mbega Ivyanditswe ntibivuga ngo: ‘Inzu yanje izoba iyo gusengerwamwo n’amahanga yose’ ? Ariko mweho mwayihinduye ‘ubwihisho bw’ibisuma.’ ”
Abaherezi bakurubakuru n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe bavyumvise baca batangura kurondera ingene bomwica. Ariko baramutinya kuko abantu bakunda cane inyigisho ziwe.
Bugorovye, Yesu n’abigishwa biwe barasohoka bava mu gisagara.
Bukeye mu gitondo, bariko baragenda, babona ca giti c’umusukoni Yesu yavuma cumye kuva mu mizi.
Petero aca aravyibuka maze abwira Yesu ati: “Mwigisha, ehe ca giti wavuma cumye!”
Yesu aca ababwira ati: “Mukomere mu kwizera Imana.
Ndababwire ukuri, umuntu yobwira uwu musozi ati: ‘Shinguka, witerere mu kiyaga,’ avyizeye adakekeranya mu mutima wiwe ariko yizeye ko ivyo avuze biba, vyogenda nk’uko yabisavye.
Ni co gituma ndababwira ko ico muzosaba cose mu gusenga, mukwiye kwizera ko mwamaze kukironka, kandi Imana izokibaha.
Ariko imbere y’uko mutangura gusenga, mubanze muharire umuntu wese yabacumuyeko, kugira ngo So wo mw’ijuru na we abaharire ivyaha vyanyu. [
Ariko nimutaharira abandi, na So wo mw’ijuru ntazobaharira ivyaha mwakoze. ] ”
Nuko Yesu n’abigishwa biwe basubira i Yerusalemu. Yesu ariko aragendagenda mu rusengero, abaherezi bakurubakuru, abigisha b’ivyagezwe, n’abakuru b’Abayuda baza aho ari,
baramubaza bati: “Ni ubuhe bubasha butuma ukora ivyo? Ni nde yabuguhaye?”
Yesu arabishura ati: “Reka nanje ndababaze ikibazo kimwe; munyishure, nce ndababwira aho ububasha butuma nkora ibi buva.
Mbega umubatizo wa Yohana wavuye mw’ijuru ku Mana canke ku bantu? Nimunyishure.”
Baravugana hagati yabo bati: “Nitwavuga tuti: ‘Wavuye mw’ijuru,’ ahava atubaza ati: ‘None ni kuki mutizeye ivyo Yohana yavuze?’
Kandi ntitwovuga tuti: ‘Wavuye ku bantu.’ ” Kuko baratinya isinzi ry’abantu bari aho, kuko abantu bose baremera ko Yohana yari uwuvugishwa n’Imana.
Ni ko kwishura Yesu bati: “Ntituzi aho wavuye.” Na we aca ababwira ati: “Nanje sindababwira aho ububasha butuma nkora ibi buva.”

headings.text: Babaza Yesu aho ubushobozi bwiwe buva

verses.text: Nuko Yesu atangura kubigisha akoresheje imigani. Arababwira ati: “Umuntu yateye imizabibu mw’itongo ryiwe, ararizitirira, yimba ikinogo co kuganiramwo imizabibu, yubaka n’umunara wo gucungererako urwo ruzabibu. Hanyuma azeza uwo murima abarimyi, afata urugendo rwa kure.
Iyimbura rigeze, atuma umukozi wiwe kuri ba barimyi gutora igice c’umwimbu kimwegukira.
Ba barimyi bafata uwo mukozi, baramukubita, bamurungika iminwe misa.
Yongera arungika uwundi mukozi, na we baramucokora, bongera bamukubita mu mutwe.
Hanyuma arungika uwundi mukozi, uwo we baca baramwica. Yarungitse abakozi benshi, bamwe barabakubita, abandi barabica.
Umuhungu wiwe akunda cane ni we yari asigaranye yashobora gutuma. Nuko amurungika ubwa nyuma yibwira ati: ‘Umuhungu wanje we bazomusonera.’
Ariko ba barimyi bamubonye baravugana bati: ‘Uwu ni we azoba samuragwa. Reka tumwice kugira ngo twegukire ivyo yorazwe.’
Nuko baca baramufata, baramwica, bamukwegera inyuma y’umurima w’uruzabibu.
None mwibaza ko nyene uruzabibu niyaza azobagira gute? Azoza yice abo barimyi, maze urwo ruzabibu aruzeze abandi.
Mbega ntimurasoma aya majambo yo mu Vyanditswe avuga ngo: ‘Ibuye abubatsi bagaye, ni ryo ryahindutse irigumya imfuruka;
ibi Uhoraho ni we yabikoze, kandi ni igitangaza mu maso yacu’ ?”

Nuko abaherezi bakurubakuru, abigisha b’ivyagezwe n’abakuru b’ubwo bwoko barondera ingene bomufata kuko bari batahuye ko ari bo yariko aravuga muri uwo mugani. Ariko barabitinya kubera abantu, baca bamusiga ngaho baragenda.
Mu nyuma abakuru b’idini barungika bamwe mu Bafarisayo bari kumwe n’abashigikiye Herode Antipa kugira ngo batege umutego Yesu, bamufatire ku majambo avuga.

Baza aho ari baramubaza bati: “Mwigisha, turazi ko uri umuntu w’imvugakuri. Wewe ntutinya igitsure c’abantu, kuko ntuterwa ubwoba n’igihagararo cabo, ahubwo wigisha inzira ihimbara Imana mu kuri kwose. None tubwire: Biremewe gutanga ikori rija kwa Kayisari canke ntivyemewe?
Dukwiye kuritanga canke ntidukwiye kuritanga?” Ariko kuko Yesu yari azi uburyarya bwabo, arabishura ati: “Ni kuki muriko mugerageza kuntega umutego? Nzanira igiceri c’idenariyo ico ndaba.”
Nuko barakimuzanira. Arababaza ati: “Mbega iyi shusho n’ibi vyandiko biriko ni ivya nde?” Na bo bati: “Ni ivya Kayisari.”
Na we asubizayo ati: “Ivya Kayisari nimubihe Kayisari, ivy’Imana mubihe Imana.” Maze iyo nyishu irabatangaza cane.
Hanyuma Abasadukayo, basanzwe bavuga ko abapfuye batazozuka, baza aho ari baramubaza bati:
“Mwigisha, Mose yaduhaye ivyagezwe bivuga ko iyo umuntu apfuye, agasiga umugore atagira abana, uwo bavukana ategerezwa kurongora uwo mupfakazi kugira ngo aronkere uruvyaro uwo yapfuye.
Rero, harigeze kuba abavukana indwi. Mukuru muri bo ararongora, ariko apfa atavyaye.
Hanyuma uwa kabiri arongora wa mupfakazi, ariko na we nyene apfa atavyaye. Umuhungu wa gatatu na we nyene bimugendera gutyo.
Bibandanya uko, ku buryo ata muhungu n’umwe yamusigaranye abana. Maze mu nyuma wa mugore na we arapfa.
None ku musi w’izuka ry’abapfuye, uwo mugore azoba uwa nde, ko yabaye umugore w’abo bose uko ari indwi?”
Yesu arabishura ati: “Mwarazimiye kuko mudatahura ico Ivyanditswe bivuga, ntimumenye n’ubushobozi bw’Imana.
Aho abapfuye bazozukira, abantu ntibazorongora canke ngo barongorwe, kuko bazoba bameze nk’abamarayika bo mw’ijuru.
Ku bijanye n’izuka ry’abapfuye, mbega nta ho murasoma mu gitabu ca Mose, aho yandika ivy’igisaka caka kidatemuka, ko Imana yamubwiye iti: ‘Ndi Imana ya Aburahamu, ya Isaka, na Yakobo’ ?
Si Imana y’abapfuye, ahubwo ni Imana y’abazima. Mwarazimiye cane!”
Umwe mu bigisha b’ivyagezwe yari ahagaze ngaho yumviriza ingene bavugana; yumvise ko Yesu yishuye neza Abasadukayo, aramubaza ati: “Ibwirizwa riruta ayandi yose ni irihe?”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Ibwirizwa riruta ayandi yose ni iri: ‘Umviriza yewe Isirayeli! Uhoraho Imana yawe, ni yo Mana imwe rudende.
Ukundishe Uhoraho Imana yawe umutima wawe wose, umushaha wawe wose, ubwenge bwawe bwose n’inkomezi zawe zose.’
Irya kabiri ni iri: ‘Ukunde mugenzawe nk’uko wikunda.’ Nta bwirizwa ryoza riruta ayo.”
Wa mwigisha w’ivyagezwe arishura ati: “Mwigisha, wishuye neza cane! Ivyo uvuze ni ukuri; ko Imana ari imwe kandi ko ata yindi iriho kiretse yo yonyene;

kandi ko dukwiye kuyikundisha imitima yacu yose, ubwenge bwacu bwose; n’inkomezi zacu zose, kandi tugakunda bagenzi bacu nk’uko twikunda. Ivyo birahambaye kurusha gushikanira Imana ayandi mashikanwa yose n’ibimazi vy’ibikoko.”
Yesu abonye ko yishuranye ubwenge, aramubwira ati: “Nturi kure y’Ubwami bw’Imana.” Inyuma y’ivyo nta muntu yasubiye kwubahuka kumubaza ibibazo.
Hanyuma, Yesu ariko arigisha mu rusengero, abaza ati: “Mbega ni kuki abigisha b’ivyagezwe bavuga ko Kristo ari umwana wa Dawidi?
Dawidi ubwiwe, aho yavugishwa na Mpwemu Yera, yavuze ati: ‘Uhoraho yabwiye Umwami wanje ati: Icara i buryo bwanje, kugeza abansi bawe bose, ndabashize musi y’ibirenge vyawe.’
None ko Dawidi ubwiwe amwita Umwami, yoba umwana wiwe gute?” Abantu benshi bari ngaho bamwumviriza buzuye umunezero.
Yesu akiriko arigisha, arongera avuga ati: “Mwirinde abigisha b’ivyagezwe. Bakunda kugendagenda bambaye amakanzu maremare y’icubahiro, no kuramutswa mu cubahiro mu makoraniro y’abantu.
Bakunda kandi guhabwa ivyicaro vy’icubahiro mu masinagogi no mu misi mikuru y’amazimano.
Barya amazu y’abapfakazi bakabatwara ivyabo, kandi bakabandanya biyerekana nk’abantu beza mu gusenga amasengesho maremare. Ni co gituma bazohanwa kurusha abandi.”
Nuko Yesu yicara hafi y’ico batorezamwo amashikanwa mu rusengero, araba ingene abantu bashiramwo amahera y’ishikanwa. Benshi mu batunzi batanga menshi.
Ariko umupfakazi umwe araza ashiramwo ibiceri bibiri vy’agaciro gato cane.
Nuko Yesu ahamagara abigishwa biwe arababwira ati: “Ndababwire ukuri, uwu mupfakazi w’umukene atanze ishikanwa rinini kurusha abandi bose.
Bose batanze ku musesekara w’ubutunzi bwabo; ariko we, mu bukene bwiwe, atanze ivyomubeshejeho vyose.”
Yesu ariko arasohoka ava mu rusengero, umwe mu bigishwa biwe aramubwira ati: “Mwigisha, ehe raba izi nyubakwa n’amabuye azubatse ingene biteye igomwe!”
Yesu arabishura ati: “Murabona izi nyubakwa zihambaye? Nta buye na rimwe rizosigara rigeretse ku rindi; yose azosamburirwa hasi.”
Hanyuma Yesu yicaye ku Musozi wa Elayono aharabana n’urusengero, Petero, Yakobo, Yohana na Andereya baramubaza biherereye bati:
“Tubwire, ivyo bizoshika ryari, kandi ni ikihe kimenyetso kizokwerekana ko bigiye gushika?”
Yesu atangura kubabwira ati: “Mwiyubare ntihagire umuntu abazimiza,
kuko benshi bazoza mw’izina ryanje, bavuga bati: ‘Ni jewe Kristo!’ kandi bazozimiza benshi.
Nimwumva intambara n’inkuru zivuga ivy’intambara hirya no hino, ntimuze muhagarike imitima. Ivyo bitegerezwa gushika, ariko iherezo rya vyose ntirizoba rirashika.
Ihanga rizotera irindi hanga, ubwami butere ubundi bwami. Ahantu henshi kw’isi hazoba nyamugigima n’ikigoyi. Ariko ivyo bizoba ari nk’intango y’ibise.
Mube maso! Bazobafata babajane imbere y’abacamanza, kandi bazobakubitira mu masinagogi. Muzohagarara imbere y’abatware n’abami muzira kuba abigishwa banje, kugira ngo munshingire intahe imbere yabo.
Kuko Ubutumwa Bwiza butegerezwa kubanza kuvugwa mu mahanga yose.
Nibabafata bakabashengeza, ntimuze muhagarikwe imitima n’ivyo muzovuga. Muze muvuge ico muzohabwa ako kanya, kuko mutazovuga ivyo mwigeneye, ariko muzovuga ivyo muhawe na Mpwemu Yera.
Umuntu azotanga uwo bavukana ngo bamwice, n’umuvyeyi agirire umwana wiwe uko. Abana bazogarariza abavyeyi babo banabicishe.
Abantu bose bazobanka babahora izina ryanje. Ariko uwuzokwihangana gushitsa kw’iherezo azokizwa.
Nimwabona ca ‘kizira gihumanya’ gihagaze aho kidakwiye guhagarara; uwusoma natahure, abazoba bari i Yudaya baze bahungire ku misozi.
Uwuzoba ari hejuru ku nzu, ntazosubire mu nzu kurondera ivyo ahungana.
Uwuzoba ari mu murima ntaze asubire i muhira gutora impuzu.
Ese ukuntu iyo misi izoba ari iy’umubabaro utagira uko ungana ku bagore bibungenze n’abazoba bonsa!
Musenge kugira ngo ntibize bishike mu gihe c’imbeho nyinshi cane,
azoba ari imisi y’umubabaro n’agahinda bitigeze bibaho kuva Imana irema isi kugeza ubu, kandi bitazosubira kubaho.
Iyo Umwami Imana atagabanya iyo misi, nta muntu n’umwe yorokotse. Ariko kubera abatoranijwe, iyo misi yarayigabanije.
Muri ico gihe nihagira umuntu ababwira ati: ‘Ehe Kristo ari hano!’ canke ngo, ‘Ehe ng’uriya!’ ntimuze muvyemere.
Kuko abiyita Kristo n’abavugishwa b’ibinyoma bazoza ari benshi, bakore ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza kugira ngo bishobotse bazimize n’abatoranijwe.
Nuko mube maso, kuko ndabibabwiye imbere y’uko bishika.
Muri iyo misi, inyuma y’ayo makuba, ‘izuba rizocura umwijima, n’ukwezi ntikuzosubira kubonesha,
inyenyeri zizokoragurika ziva kw’ijuru, kandi n’ivy’inkomezi biri mu kirere bizonyiganyizwa.’
Ni ho abantu bazobona Umwana w’Umuntu aserutse mu bicu afise ubushobozi buhambaye n’ubwiza bwinshi.
Azotuma abamarayika biwe bakoranye abatoranijwe na we babakuye ku mpande zine z’isi, kuva aho itangurira gushika aho amajuru aherera.
Nimwigire ku giti c’umusukoni: iyo amashami yaco atanguye gutoha, amababi na yo agatutuza, muca mumenya ko agatasi kari hafi.
Nuko namwe, nimwabona ivyo vyose, muzoce mumenya neza ko ukugaruka kwiwe kuri hafi, ko ageze kw’irembo.
Ndababwire ukuri, abo muri runo runganwe ntibazopfa bose ivyo vyose bitarashika.
Ijuru n’isi bizokurwaho, ariko amajambo yanje ntazovaho.
Ariko ku bijanye n’umusi canke isaha, baba abamarayika bo mw’ijuru, canke Umwana ubwiwe, nta n’umwe abizi uretse Data wenyene.
Nuko rero mwame mugavye, muterame, kuko mutazi aho ico gihe kizoshikira.
Ukuza kw’Umwana w’Umuntu kugereranywa n’urugendo umuntu yateguye. Agira ave i muhira, yabwiye abakozi biwe bose ivyo bategerezwa gusigara barakora, hanyuma abwira umuteramyi kuba maso.
None rero mube maso kuko mutazi igihe nyene inzu azogarukirako; hashobora kuba ku mugoroba, mu gicugu, mw’ijoro rishira ubuca canke kare mu gitondo.
Niyaza giturumbuka, ntaze asange musinziriye.
Ibi ndabibwiye mwebwe, ndabibwira n’abandi bose: ‘Nimube maso!’ ”

Ico gihe hari hasigaye imisi ibiri ngo umusi mukuru wa Pasika n’umusi mukuru w’imikate itarimwo umwambiro ishike. Kandi abaherezi bakurubakuru n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe bariko barondera akaryo ko gufata Yesu mu mpisho kugira ngo bamwice.
Barumvikana bati: “Ntidukwiye kumufata mu gihe c’imisi mikuru kuko abantu bohava bagumuka.”

Ico gihe Yesu yari i Betaniya mu nzu kwa Simoni yahoze ari umunyamibembe. Ariko arafungura, haza umugore afise icupa ryiza ririmwo amavuta amota cane kandi y’igiciro kinini ahinguwe mu giti bita narada. Nuko yugurura rya cupa, asuka ya mavuta ku mutwe wa Yesu.
Bamwe mu bari aho bongorerana bababaye bati: “Ni kuki yononye ayo mavuta?
Iyo agurishwa yari kuvamwo idenariyo zirenga amajana atatu, maze ayo mahera agafasha aboro.” Uwo mugore baramunebagura cane.
Yesu arababwira ati: “Mbega uwu mugore mumugorera iki? Ankoreye ikintu ciza.
Aboro muzokwamana, kandi murashobora kubafasha igihe cose mubishakiye. Ariko jewe ntimuzonyamana.
Akoze ivyo ashoboye. Asutse aya mavuta ku mubiri wanje hakiri kare, kugira ngo awutegurire guhambwa.
Ndababwire ukuri, kw’isi yose aho ubu Butumwa Bwiza buzovugwa, ibi akoze bizovugwa, bitume yama yibukwa.”
Hanyuma, Yuda Isikariyote, umwe muri ba bigishwa cumi na babiri, aja kurondera abaherezi bakurubakuru ngo bavugane ingene yobashikiriza Yesu.
Maze baranezerwa cane, baca bamwemerera amahera; na we aca atangura kurondera akaryo keza ko kumubashikiriza.

Ku musi wa mbere w’imisi mikuru y’imikate itarimwo umwambiro, hari umugenzo wo gutanga ikimazi c’umwagazi w’intama wa Pasika. Nuko abigishwa babaza Yesu bati: “Ni hehe ugomba ko tugutegurira ivyokurya vya Pasika?”
Nuko arungika bibiri mu bigishwa biwe, arababwira ati: “Nimugende mu gisagara, mu nzira muraja guhura n’umuntu yikoreye umubindi w’amazi, muce mumukurikira.
Ashitse aho agiye, mubwire nyene urugo ko Umwigisha ashaka kumenya ahari icumba c’abashitsi aja gusangiriramwo ivya Pasika n’abigishwa biwe.
Na we araja kubereka icumba kinini co hejuru, kirimwo ibikenewe vyose. Aho abe ari ho mudutegurira ivya Pasika.”
Nuko ba bigishwa baragenda, baja mu gisagara basanga ibintu bimeze nk’uko Yesu yabibabwiye, baca bategura ivyokurya vya Pasika.
Hageze ku mugoroba, Yesu aca arashika ari kumwe n’abigishwa biwe cumi na babiri.
Bariko barafungura, Yesu avuga ati: “Ndababwire ukuri, umwe muri mwebwe turiko turasangira ahava angurisha.”
Abigishwa baca barababara, umwe wese aramubaza ati: “Yoba ari jewe?”
Arabishura ati: “Ni umwe muri mwebwe cumi na babiri, uwo duhurije ukuboko mw’isahani.
Umwana w’Umuntu agiye gupfa nk’uko Ivyanditswe bivuga. Ariko aragowe uwo muntu amugurishije! Vyari kumubera vyiza iyo atavuka!”
Bariko barafungura, Yesu afata umukate, awushimira Imana, arawumanyura, awuha abigishwa biwe, avuga ati: “Nimwakire murye, uwu ni umubiri wanje.”
Yongera afata igikombe, ahejeje kugishimira Imana, agiha abigishwa biwe, maze bose bakinywako.
Arababwira ati: “Aya ni amaraso yanje y’isezerano hagati y’Imana n’abantu bayo, asesetse ku bwa benshi.
Ndababwire ukuri, sinzosubira kunywa ku muvinyu w’imizabibu gushitsa kuri wa musi aho nzosubira kuwunywa ari mushasha mu Bwami bw’Imana.”
Bahejeje kuririmba barasohoka baja ku Musozi wa Elayono.
Yesu arababwira ati: “Mwese muhava muhunga, munte jenyene. Kuko Ivyanditswe bivuga ngo: ‘Nzokubita umwungere, intama zisanzare.’
Ariko maze kuzuka, nzobitangira imbere kuja i Galilaya, ndabarindirireyo.”
Petero aramubwira ati: “Naho bose boguta bagahunga, jewe sinzoguta.”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Ndakubwire ukuri, iri joro nyene, imbere yuko isake ibika kabiri, wewe nyene uzoba umaze kunyihakana gatatu kose uvuga ko utanzi.”
Ariko Petero abisubiramwo ashimitse ati: “Sinshobora kukwihakana ngo sindakuzi naho vyonsaba gupfana nawe.” N’abandi bigishwa bavuga gutyo nyene.
Nuko baja ahantu hitwa Getsemane, maze Yesu abwira abigishwa biwe ati: “Nimube muricaye ngaha nanje nje gusenga.”
Nuko ajana na Petero, na Yakobo na Yohana, maze atangura kugira agahinda kenshi cane no guhagarika umutima.
Arababwira ati: “Umutima wanje wuzuye agahinda gashobora kunyica. Nimube muragumye ngaha mubane maso nanje.”
Nuko yigira imbere, yubama hasi arasenga asaba ngo iyo saha imurengane.
Aravuga ati: \+wj “Aba,\+wj* Data, wewe vyose biragushobokera. Ndakwinginze unkure imbere iki gikombe c’imibabaro. Ariko ntibibe nk’uko jewe ngomba, yamara bibe uko wewe ugomba.”
Nuko agaruka aho abigishwa biwe bari asanga basinziriye. Abaza Petero ati: “Simoni, urasinziriye? Ntiwashoboye kubana maso nanje n’isaha n’imwe?
Nimube maso musenge kugira ngo ntimutsindwe n’ibibagerageza. Umutima urabikunze, ariko umubiri ufise intege nke.”
Asubira kwigira imbere, asenga asubiramwo ya majambo nyene.
Agarutse, asanga basubiriye gusinzira, kuko amaso yabo yari aremerewe cane n’itiro, maze babura ico bamubwira.
Agarutse aho bari ubugira gatatu, arababaza ati: “Mbega n’ubu muracasinziriye, muriruhukiye? Ehe, isaha irageze, Umwana w’Umuntu agira atangwe mu maboko y’abanyavyaha.
Nimuvyuke tugende. Nguwo uwangurishije arashitse!”

Yesu akiriko aravuga, Yuda Isikariyote, umwe muri ba bigishwa cumi na babiri arashika. Inyuma yiwe hari isinzi ry’abantu bitwaje inkota n’amahiri, barungitswe n’abaherezi bakurubakuru n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe n’abatware.
Yuda, uwari yamugurishije yari yabahaye ikimenyetso, ababwira ati: “Uwo nja gusoma azoba ari we. Muce mumufata mumujane, kandi mumucunge cane!”
Babashikiriye, Yuda agenda atumbereye Yesu, avuga ati: “Rabi!” Aca aramusoma.
Nuko ba bantu bashorera amaboko kuri Yesu baramufata.
Umwe mu bari hafi ya Yesu asokora inkota yiwe ayikubita umukozi w’umuherezi mukuru, amuca ugutwi.
Yesu aravuga ati: “Mbega mbaye umugumutsi, aho muza kumfata mwitwaje amahiri?
Imisi yose namana namwe mu rusengero nigisha, ariko ntimwigeze mumfata. Ariko ibi bibaye kugira ngo Ivyanditswe bishike.”
Nuko bose baramuta barahunga.
Ariko umusore umwe agerageza gukurikira Yesu yambaye umutamana wonyene, na we nyene baza kumufata,
aca abatana wa mutamana ahunga ari gusa.
Nuko bafata Yesu bamujana mu rugo rw’umuherezi mukuru, ahari hakoraniye abaherezi bakurubakuru, abatware, n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe.
Petero aguma amukurikira agendera inyuma kure, maze ashika mu rugo rw’umuherezi mukuru, aca yicarana n’abarinzi b’urugo, yota umuriro.
Abaherezi bakurubakuru n’abagize inama nkuru y’idini ry’Abayuda, bagerageza kurondera ibirego vyotuma Yesu acirwa urubanza rwo gupfa, ariko ntibaronka na kimwe.
Bamwe mu bamwagiriza bagerageza kumubeshera, ariko ntibahuza ku vyo bamurega.
Nuko bamwe barahaguruka bamwagiriza ibinyoma bati:
“Twamwumvise avuga ngo: ‘Nzosambura uru rusengero rwubatswe n’abantu, hanyuma mu misi itatu nubake urundi, rutubatswe n’abantu.’ ”
Ariko n’ivyo birego na vyo ntibabihurizako.
Hanyuma umuherezi mukuru aca arahaguruka imbere ya bose, abaza Yesu ati: “None wewe nta co wireguza? Ibi birego bakwagiriza ubivugako iki?”
Ariko Yesu arihorera ntiyagira ico amwishura. Wa muherezi mukuru arongera aramubaza ati: “Uri Kristo, Umwana w’Iyihezagiwe?”
Yesu arishura ati: “Ndi we! Kandi muzobona Umwana w’Umuntu yicaye mu kibanza c’icubahiro i buryo bw’Imana y’ububasha, kandi azananye n’ibicu vyo kw’ijuru.”
Wa muherezi mukuru yitaburirako impuzu, avuga ati: “None hari ibindi vyabona dukeneye?
Ubu naho ntimwiyumviye ingene atutse Imana? Nimugire ico mubivuzeko.” Bose baca bamucira urubanza ko akwiye gupfa!
Bamwe batangura kumucirako; bamupfunga amaso, bamukubita ingumu, bavuga bati: “Vugishwa, utubwire uwugukubise!” Hanyuma ba barinzi baca baramujana, bamukubita amakofe.
Petero akiri hepfo mu rugo, umwe mu bakobwa bakorera umuherezi mukuru aza aho ari.
Abonye Petero ariko arota, aramwihweza cane. Maze amubwira ati: “Na wewe wari kumwe na Yesu Umunyanazareti.”
Ariko Petero arabihakana ati: “Sinzi kandi sintahura ivyo uriko uravuga!” Nuko aca ava mu rugo aja kw’irembo.
Wa mukobwa abonye ko Petero ahagaze kw’irembo, aca abwira abari ngaho ati: “Uwu mugabo ni umwe mu bigishwa biwe!”
Petero yongera kubihakana. Haheze akanya, abari bahagaze hafi ya Petero baramubwira bati: “Ni ivy’ukuri uri umwe muri bo, kuko uri Umunyagalilaya.”
Petero atangura kurahira yisiba ati: “Ndabarahiye, uwo mugabo sindamuzi.”

Uwo mwanya nyene isake ica ibika ubugira kabiri. Nuko Petero na we aca aribuka ijambo Yesu yari yamubwiye ati: “Isake itarabika kabiri, uzoba umaze kunyihakana gatatu kose, uvuga ko utanzi.” Maze aca araturikisha ararira.

headings.text: Yesu asangira n’abigishwa biwe ubwa nyuma
Yesu avuga ko Petero ahava amwihakana

verses.text: Hakiri kare mu gatondo, abaherezi bakurubakuru hamwe n’abatware, n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe, ari bo bari bagize inama nkuru y’idini ry’Abayuda barakorana, bagira inama. Nuko baboha Yesu, bamujana kwa Pilato.
Pilato aramubaza ati: “Woba uri umwami w’Abayuda?” Yesu aramwishura ati: “Uvuze ukuri, ndi we.”
Maze abaherezi bakurubakuru bamurega ibirego vyinshi.
Pilato aramubaza ati: “Mbega nta co wishura? Mbega ntiwumva ivyo bakurega?”
Ariko Yesu ntiyagira ico yishura, bituma Pilato atangara.
Igihe cose mu misi mikuru ya Pasika, hari umugenzo wo kurekura imbohe abantu bisabiye.
Hariho umugabo yitwa Baraba yari mw’ibohero kuko we na bagenziwe bagirizwa ubwicanyi mu migumuko.
Nuko abantu baraza basaba Pilato kubarekurira imbohe nk’uko yari asanzwe abikora.
Pilato arababaza ati: “Mushaka ko ndabarekurira Umwami w’Abayuda?”
Yari azi neza ko abaherezi bakurubakuru bamuzaniye Yesu kubera ishari.
Abaherezi bakurubakuru batangura kugumura abantu ngo basabe Pilato abarekurire Baraba mu kibanza ca Yesu.
Pilato arababaza ati: “None uwo mwita umwami w’Abayuda ndamugire nte?”
Barasemerera bati: “Nabambwe!”
Pilato arababaza ati: “Kubera iki? Ni ikihe caha yakoze?” Ariko barushiriza gusemerera bati: “Nabambwe!”
Mu ntumbero yo kunezereza abantu benshi bari aho, Pilato arekura Baraba. Atanga itegeko ko bashishagura Yesu, hanyuma aramutanga kugira ngo bamubambe.
Nuko abasoda bajana Yesu mu rugo rw’imbere; ni ukuvuga aho umutware w’Umuroma yakorera, bahamagara abandi basoda bagize umugwi wabo,
bamwambika ikanzu itukura, bajisha urugori rw’amahwa, barumwambika mu mutwe.
Nuko batangura kumucokora bati: “Turagize bwakeye, mwami w’Abayuda!”
Baguma bamukubita irenga mu mutwe, bamucirako amate. Bapfukama imbere yiwe bamushinyagurira ngo baramwubashe.
Bahejeje kumushinyagurira, bamwambura ya kanzu itukura basubira kumwambika impuzu ziwe, hanyuma bamujana kumubamba.
Bakiri mu nzira bagenda, bahura n’umugabo yitwa Simoni yari avuye mu mirima, bamutegeka gutwaza umusaraba Yesu. Simoni yava i Kurene kandi yari se wa Alegizandere na Rufu.
Nuko bashikana Yesu ahantu hitwa Gologota (bisigura “Ahantu h’Agahanga”).
Bagerageza kumuha umuvinyu w’inkarisha, ariko yanka kuwunywa.
Nuko baramubamba, bagabura impuzu ziwe bakoresheje ubupfindo kugira ngo barabe iyo umwumwe wese yotwara.
Igihe bamubamba hari nk’isaha zitatu z’igitondo.
Icandiko c’ibirego vyatumye abambwa cavuga ngo: Umwami w’Abayuda.
Ba basoda bongera babamba ibisuma bibiri i ruhande ya Yesu, kimwe i buryo, ikindi i bubamfu bwiwe. [
Uko ni ko Ivyanditswe vyashitse kuko vyavuga ngo: “Yaharuwe mu gitigiri c’inkozi z’ikibi.”]
Abarengana bagenda baramutuka bamuzunguriza imitwe, bakamubwira bati: “Wewe wavuze ngo wosambura urusengero ukarwubaka mu misi itatu!
Ikize rero, wikure kuri uwo musaraba!”
N’abaherezi bakurubakuru n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe na bo bakamucokora, bavuga bati: “Yakijije abandi, ariko we ntashobora kwikiza!
Kristo, umwami w’Abisirayeli niyikure ku musaraba kugira ngo tubibone hanyuma tumwizere.” Na vya bisuma vyari bibambanywe na we na vyo biramutuka.
Kuva isaha zitandatu z’umurango, igihugu cose gitwikirwa n’umwijima gushika isaha icenda.
Isaha y’icenda ishitse, Yesu arasemerera n’ijwi rirenga ati: \+wj “Eloyi, Eloyi, lema sabakitani?”\+wj* bisobanurwa ngo: “Mana yanje, Mana yanje, ni kuki wampevye?”
Bamwe mu bari bahagaze aho baravuga bati: “Mwumvise? Ariko ahamagara Eliya!”
Umwe ariruka afata sipongo ayijobeka mu nkarisha, ayishira kw’irenga, aca arariduza ku munwa wa Yesu kugira ngo amunyweshe, aravuga ati: “Reka turabe ko Eliya aza kumumanura, amukure ku musaraba.”
Nuko Yesu araboroga, aca aracikana.
Igitambara co mu rusengero gica gitabukamwo kubiri kuva hejuru gushika hasi.
Intwazangabo y’Umuroma yari ahagaze imbere ya Yesu, abonye ingene apfuye, aravuga ati: “Ni ivy’ukuri uwu yari Umwana w’Imana!”
Ico gihe hariho abagore babirabira kure. Muri bo harimwo Mariya Magadalena, Mariya nyina wa Yakobo mutoya na Yose, hamwe na Salome.
Abo bagore bagendana na Yesu igihe yari i Galilaya bakamushigikira. Hari n’abandi bagore benshi bari bazananye na we i Yerusalemu bari ngaho.
Uwo musi wari uwo kwitegurira Isabato, ni ukuvuga buca haba Isabato. Nuko hageze ku mugoroba,

Yosefu w’i Arimataya, arahaguruka n’ubutwari bwinshi, aja kwa Pilato amusaba ikiziga ca Yesu. Uwo Yosefu yari umwubahwa mu bagize inama nkuru y’ubwoko bw’Abayuda kandi yari yiteze ukuza kw’Ubwami bw’Imana.
Pilato aca aratangara yumvise ko Yesu yamaze gucikana. Nuko ahamagara ya ntwazangabo y’Umuroma amubaza ko Yesu yamaze gupfa.
Na we amubwira ko ari vyo. Pilato aca aha uruhusha Yosefu rwo gutora ikiziga ca Yesu.

Maze Yosefu aca agura igitambara cera, akura ikiziga ca Yesu ku musaraba, akizingira muri ico gitambara cera, agishira mu mva yimbwe mu gitandara; aca atembagariza ikibuye kinini ku muryango wa ya mva arayugara.
Kandi ico gihe Mariya Magadalena na Mariya nyina wa Yose bariko bararaba aho bashize ikiziga ca Yesu.
Isabato iheze, Mariya Magadalena, Mariya nyina wa Yakobo na Salome baja kugura amavuta amota neza, ngo baje kuyasiga umubiri wa Yesu.
Kare mu gitondo ku musi wa mbere utangura iyinga, izuba riserutse, bafata inzira baja ku mva.
Bariko baragenda barabazanya bati: “Ni nde aja kudukurira ca kibuye ku muryango w’imva?”
Ariko bahashitse, bararaba babona ca kibuye camaze kuvaho.
Binjiye mu mva, babona umuntu asa n’umusore yambaye ikanzu yera cane, yicaye ku ruhande rw’i buryo, maze bagira ubwoba.
Na we arabaremesha ati: “Ntimugire ubwoba! Ndazi ko murondera Yesu w’i Nazareti, umwe babamba. Ntari hano kuko yazutse! Nimuze murabe aho bari baryamitse ikiziga ciwe!
Nimugende mubibwire abigishwa biwe, na canecane Petero, ko Yesu agiye kubarindirira i Galilaya. Aho ni ho muzomubonera nk’uko yabibabwiye.”
